17: parameter int EXP_WIDTH        = 8;   // 8-bit Log-Scale Exponent
18: parameter int DATA_BUS_WIDTH   = BLOCK_SIZE * FP4_WIDTH; // 64 bits
19: parameter int PACKET_WIDTH     = DATA_BUS_WIDTH + EXP_WIDTH; // 72 bits (64b data + 8b exp)
20:

22: parameter int ACCUMULATOR_DEPTH= `ACC_DEPTH_SYN;  // Default Accumulator Depth (N_tile)

24: parameter int BIN_WIDTH        = 32;  // 32-bit signed accumulator per bin
25: 
26: // FEBA precision: pre-shift the intra-block dot product by GUARD_BITS before the
27: // octave barrel shift, so the right shift discards zero padding instead of real
28: // data (Q2 -> Q(2+GUARD_BITS)). Q_LEFT_MAX caps the positive octave shift so the
29: // 32-bit datapath cannot overflow.
30: parameter int GUARD_BITS       = 12;  // pre-shift guard bits
31: parameter int Q_LEFT_MAX       = 6;   // cap for positive q (overflow guard)
32: parameter int PROD_INT_WIDTH   = 16;  // 16-bit signed intra-block dot-product result
33: parameter int UCS_OUT_WIDTH    = 36;  // 36-bit intermediate scaled product in UCS
34: parameter int FP16_WIDTH       = 16;  // 16-bit FP16 result output
35: parameter int VEC_RES_WIDTH    = NUM_LANES * FP16_WIDTH; // 256 bits parallel vector output
36: 
37: `endif // PE_DEFINES_SVH

1: // =============================================================================
2: // Module: snax_llm_top.sv
3: // Description: Top-Level Complete Subsystem tích hợp:
4: //              - 32-Bank Single-Port SRAM (DW=72, Strb=9, Tổng 288 KB)
5: //              - Interleaved Crossbar Interconnect (18 Masters x 32 Banks)
6: //              - 16x Weight Streamer Channels (1152 bits/cycle)
7: //              - 1x Activation Streamer Channel (72 bits/cycle với Freeze Mode)
8: //              - 1x Output Write Streamer (72-bit Packet)
9: //              - SNAX Fused LLM Shell (FP4 DotProduct + Exp-Free Softmax + Normalizer)
10: // =============================================================================
11: `timescale 1ns/1ps
12: `include "pe_defines.svh"
13: 
14: module snax_llm_top #(
15:     parameter int unsigned DATA_WIDTH     = 72,   // 72-bit Packet (64b FP4 + 8b Exp)
16:     parameter int unsigned STRB_WIDTH     = 9,    // 9 bytes per word
17:     parameter int unsigned ADDR_WIDTH     = 32,   // 32-bit Address
18:     parameter int unsigned NUM_BANKS      = 32,   // 32 Banks SRAM TCDM
19:     parameter int unsigned BANK_DEPTH     = 1024, // 1024 words x 9 bytes = 9 KB / bank (Tổng 288 KB)
20:     parameter int unsigned NUM_LANES_P    = NUM_LANES,        // 16 Lanes
21:     parameter int unsigned ACC_DEPTH_P    = ACCUMULATOR_DEPTH // 64 / 128
22: )(
23:     input  logic                                  clk,
24:     input  logic                                  rst_n,
25: 
26:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
27:     // 1. Host CSR Interface (Từ RISC-V Snitch Core / CPU Host)
28:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
29:     input  logic                                  host_csr_we_i,
30:     input  logic [11:0]                           host_csr_addr_i,
31:     input  logic [31:0]                           host_csr_wdata_i,
32:     output logic [31:0]                           host_csr_rdata_o,
33: 
34:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
35:     // 2. Host Direct Memory Access / iDMA Port (Nạp dữ liệu ngoài DRAM vào TCDM)
36:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
37:     input  logic                                  host_mem_req_valid_i,
38:     output logic                                  host_mem_req_ready_o,
39:     input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]                 host_mem_req_addr_i,
40:     input  logic                                  host_mem_req_write_i,
41:     input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                 host_mem_req_wdata_i,
42:     input  logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0]                 host_mem_req_strb_i,
43: 
44:     output logic                                  host_mem_rsp_valid_o,
45:     output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                 host_mem_rsp_rdata_o,
46: 
47:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
48:     // 3. Status & Interrupts
49:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
50:     output logic                                  subsystem_busy_o,
51:     output logic                                  subsystem_done_irq_o
52: );

54:     localparam int unsigned NUM_MASTERS = 18;
55:     localparam int unsigned BANK_ADDR_W = $clog2(BANK_DEPTH);
56: 
57:     // =========================================================================
58:     // PHẦN 1: GIẢI MÃ ĐỊA CHỈ CSR CHO HỆ THỐNG
59:     // =========================================================================
60:     // 0x000 - 0x07F : Activation Streamer CSRs
61:     // 0x080 - 0x0FF : Weight Streamer CSRs
62:     // 0x100 - 0x17F : Output Streamer CSRs
63:     // 0x180 - 0x1FF : LLM Shell Wrapper CSRs
64: 
65:     logic [1:0] csr_target_sel;
66:     assign csr_target_sel = host_csr_addr_i[8:7];
67: 
68:     logic        csr_we_shell;
69:     logic [31:0] csr_rdata_shell;
70: 
71:     assign csr_we_shell = host_csr_we_i && (host_csr_addr_i[11:8] == 4'h1);
72: 
73:     always_comb begin
74:         if (host_csr_addr_i[11:8] == 4'h1) begin
75:             host_csr_rdata_o = csr_rdata_shell;
76:         end else begin
77:             host_csr_rdata_o = '0;
78:         end
79:     end
80: 
81:     // =========================================================================
82:     // PHẦN 2: TCDM INTERCONNECT WIRES (18 Masters x 32 Banks)
83:     // =========================================================================
84:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                  m_req_valid;
85:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                  m_req_ready;
86:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]  m_req_addr;
87:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                  m_req_write;
88:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  m_req_wdata;
89:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][STRB_WIDTH-1:0]  m_req_strb;
90: 
91:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                  m_rsp_valid;
92:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  m_rsp_rdata;
93: 
94:     // SRAM Bank Ports
95:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0]                    b_req;
96:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0]                    b_write;
97:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][BANK_ADDR_W-1:0]   b_addr;
98:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    b_wdata;
99:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][STRB_WIDTH-1:0]    b_strb;
100:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    b_rdata;
101:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0]                    b_rvalid;
102: 
103:     // --- Master 0: Host / iDMA AXI Port ---
104:     assign m_req_valid[0]       = host_mem_req_valid_i;
105:     assign host_mem_req_ready_o = m_req_ready[0];
106:     assign m_req_addr[0]        = host_mem_req_addr_i;
107:     assign m_req_write[0]       = host_mem_req_write_i;
108:     assign m_req_wdata[0]       = host_mem_req_wdata_i;
109:     assign m_req_strb[0]        = host_mem_req_strb_i;
110:     assign host_mem_rsp_valid_o = m_rsp_valid[0];
111:     assign host_mem_rsp_rdata_o = m_rsp_rdata[0];
112: 
113:     // =========================================================================
114:     // PHẦN 3: KẾT NỐI STREAMERS VÀ CORE ACCELERATOR
115:     // =========================================================================
116:     logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  act_stream_data;
117:     logic                   act_stream_valid;
118:     logic                   act_stream_ready;
119: 
120:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wt_stream_data;
121:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0] wt_stream_valid;
122:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0] wt_stream_ready;
123: 
124:     logic [NUM_LANES_P*16-1:0] out_fp16_data;
125:     logic                      out_fp16_valid;
126:     logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]     out_fp4_data;
127:     logic                      out_fp4_valid;
128: 
129:     logic shell_busy, shell_done;
130: 
131:     assign subsystem_busy_o     = shell_busy;
132:     assign subsystem_done_irq_o = shell_done;
133: 
134:     // --- Master 1: Kênh Activation Streamer (72-bit) ---
135:     // Nối trực tiếp Response từ Interconnect vào Accelerator Core
136:     assign act_stream_data  = m_rsp_rdata[1];
137:     assign act_stream_valid = m_rsp_valid[1];
138: 
139:     // Phát request đọc Activation từ TCDM
140:     assign m_req_valid[1] = act_stream_ready;
141:     assign m_req_write[1] = 1'b0;
142:     assign m_req_addr[1]  = 32'h0000_1000; // Địa chỉ base của Activation (từ AGU)
143:     assign m_req_wdata[1] = '0;
144:     assign m_req_strb[1]  = '0;
145: 
146:     // --- Masters 2..17: 16 Kênh Weight Streamer (16 x 72-bit = 1152 bits/cycle) ---
147:     genvar w;
148:     generate
149:         for (w = 0; w < NUM_LANES_P; w++) begin : GEN_WT_STREAM_PORTS
150:             localparam int unsigned M_IDX = 2 + w;
151: 
152:             assign wt_stream_data[w]  = m_rsp_rdata[M_IDX];
153:             assign wt_stream_valid[w] = m_rsp_valid[M_IDX];
154: 
155:             // Mỗi lane yêu cầu 1 word 72-bit từ TCDM song song
156:             assign m_req_valid[M_IDX] = wt_stream_ready[w];
157:             assign m_req_write[M_IDX] = 1'b0;
158:             // Địa chỉ cách nhau theo bước nhảy block (tương thích Interleaved addressing)
159:             assign m_req_addr[M_IDX]  = 32'h0000_2000 + (w * 16); 
160:             assign m_req_wdata[M_IDX] = '0;
161:             assign m_req_strb[M_IDX]  = '0;
162:         end
163:     endgenerate
164:

166:     // PHẦN 4: KHỞI TẠO SHELL WRAPPER (snax_llm_shell)
167:     // =========================================================================
168:     snax_llm_shell #(
169:         .NUM_LANES_P (NUM_LANES_P),
170:         .ACC_DEPTH_P (ACC_DEPTH_P),
171:         .PKT_W       (DATA_WIDTH)
172:     ) u_llm_shell (
173:         .clk                (clk),
174:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
175:         .csr_we_i           (csr_we_shell),
176:         .csr_addr_i         (host_csr_addr_i[7:0]),

192:         .engine_done_irq_o  (shell_done)
193:     );

197:     // =========================================================================
198:     interleaved_interconnect_72b #(
199:         .NUM_MASTERS (NUM_MASTERS),
200:         .NUM_BANKS   (NUM_BANKS),

1: // =============================================================================
2: // Module: snax_llm_shell.sv
3: // Description: SNAX Accelerator Shell Wrapper cho Fused FP4 LLM Engine
4: //              - Tích hợp CSR Manager điều khiển chế độ Prefill / Decode / GEMM
5: //              - Tích hợp bộ chốt giữ Activation Freeze cho Phase Decode (Streaming Weight)
6: //              - Phối hợp bắt tay Ready/Valid với 16 kênh Weight Streamer
7: // =============================================================================
8: `timescale 1ns/1ps
9: `include "pe_defines.svh"
10: 
11: module snax_llm_shell #(
12:     parameter int NUM_LANES_P = NUM_LANES,        // 16
13:     parameter int ACC_DEPTH_P = ACCUMULATOR_DEPTH, // 64
14:     parameter int PKT_W       = PACKET_WIDTH       // 72 bits
15: )(
16:     input  logic                                  clk,
17:     input  logic                                  rst_n,
18: 
19:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
20:     // 1. Giao tiếp SNAX CSR Manager (RW & RO Registers)
21:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
22:     input  logic                                  csr_we_i,
23:     input  logic [7:0]                            csr_addr_i,
24:     input  logic [31:0]                           csr_wdata_i,
25:     output logic [31:0]                           csr_rdata_o,
26: 
27:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
28:     // 2. Activation Stream (72-bit Packet từ Activation Streamer)
29:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
30:     input  logic [PKT_W-1:0]                      act_stream_data_i,
31:     input  logic                                  act_stream_valid_i,
32:     output logic                                  act_stream_ready_o,
33: 
34:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
35:     // 3. Weight Streams (16 Lanes song song: 16 x 72-bit = 1152 bits)
36:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
37:     input  logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][PKT_W-1:0]      wt_stream_data_i,
38:     input  logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0]                wt_stream_valid_i,
39:     output logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0]                wt_stream_ready_o,
40: 
41:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
42:     // 4. Output Streams (Kết quả tính toán đưa ra Output Streamer)
43:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
44:     // Kênh FP16 (256-bit SIMD)
45:     output logic [NUM_LANES_P*16-1:0]             out_fp16_data_o,
46:     output logic                                  out_fp16_valid_o,
47:     input  logic                                  out_fp16_ready_i,
48: 
49:     // Kênh FP4 Requantized (72-bit Packet)
50:     output logic [PKT_W-1:0]                      out_fp4_data_o,
51:     output logic                                  out_fp4_valid_o,
52:     input  logic                                  out_fp4_ready_i,
53: 
54:     // Trạng thái ra hệ thống
55:     output logic                                  engine_busy_o,
56:     output logic                                  engine_done_irq_o
57: );
58: 
59:     // =========================================================================
60:     // PHẦN 1: THANH GHI CẤU HÌNH CSR (snax_llm_csr)
61:     // =========================================================================
62:     logic [1:0]             csr_cfg_mode_q;        // 00: GEMM, 01: Attn QK, 10: Attn PV
63:     logic                   csr_cfg_row_start_q;
64:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0] csr_cfg_key_mask_q;
65:     logic                   csr_cfg_enable_slq_q;
66:     logic                   csr_start_pulse;
67:     logic [31:0]            csr_tile_k_q;
68:     logic [31:0]            csr_tile_n_q;
69: 
70:     logic                   is_busy_q, is_done_q;
71:     logic [31:0]            perf_cycles_q;
72: 
73:     // Core status
74:     logic                   core_p_fifo_full;
75:     logic                   core_p_fifo_almost_full;
76:     logic                   core_p_fifo_empty;
77:     logic                   core_l_ready;
78: 
79:     assign engine_busy_o     = is_busy_q;
80:     assign engine_done_irq_o = is_done_q;
81: 
82:     // Ghi CSR từ CPU
83:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
84:         if (!rst_n) begin
85:             csr_cfg_mode_q       <= '0;
86:             csr_cfg_row_start_q  <= 1'b0;
87:             csr_cfg_key_mask_q   <= '1; // Mặc định mở toàn bộ mask
88:             csr_cfg_enable_slq_q <= 1'b0;
89:             csr_start_pulse      <= 1'b0;
90:             csr_tile_k_q         <= '0;
91:             csr_tile_n_q         <= '0;
92:         end else begin
93:             csr_start_pulse <= 1'b0;
94:             // row_start is a one-cycle level; the core converts it to a pulse.
95:             csr_cfg_row_start_q <= 1'b0;
96:             if (csr_we_i) begin
97:                 case (csr_addr_i)
98:                     8'h00: csr_start_pulse      <= csr_wdata_i[0];
99:                     8'h04: csr_cfg_mode_q       <= csr_wdata_i[1:0];
100:                     8'h08: csr_cfg_row_start_q  <= csr_wdata_i[0];
101:                     8'h0C: csr_cfg_key_mask_q   <= csr_wdata_i[NUM_LANES_P-1:0];
102:                     8'h10: csr_cfg_enable_slq_q <= csr_wdata_i[0];
103:                     8'h14: csr_tile_k_q         <= csr_wdata_i;
104:                     8'h18: csr_tile_n_q         <= csr_wdata_i;
105:                     default: ;
106:                 endcase
107:             end
108:         end
109:     end
110: 
111:     // Đọc CSR
112:     always_comb begin
113:         case (csr_addr_i)
114:             8'h00: csr_rdata_o = {30'd0, is_done_q, is_busy_q};
115:             8'h04: csr_rdata_o = {30'd0, csr_cfg_mode_q};
116:             8'h14: csr_rdata_o = csr_tile_k_q;

125:     // =========================================================================

128:     // Trong Phase Decode (sinh từng token): activation Q chỉ cần nạp 1 lần,

135:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin

183:     wire compute_fire = is_busy_q && all_wt_valid && compute_act_valid;

188:     // Stop the activation stream with the compute.  In Mode 10 this is a

190:     assign act_stream_ready_o = is_busy_q &&
191:         ((csr_cfg_mode_q == 2'b10) ? !act_is_latched_q : compute_act_valid);

193:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
194:         if (!rst_n) begin
195:             is_busy_q           <= 1'b0;
196:             is_done_q           <= 1'b0;
197:             perf_cycles_q       <= '0;
198:             current_acc_slot_q  <= '0;
199:             k_step_cnt_q        <= '0;

201:             tile_drain_req      <= 1'b0;

207:             if (csr_start_pulse && !is_busy_q) begin
208:                 is_busy_q          <= 1'b1;
209:                 is_done_q          <= 1'b0;
210:                 perf_cycles_q      <= '0;
211:                 current_acc_slot_q <= '0;
212:                 k_step_cnt_q       <= '0;
213:                 n_tile_cnt_q       <= '0;

221:                     end else if (!core_p_fifo_almost_full) begin

224:                         tile_drain_req      <= 1'b1;
225:                         tile_drain_idx      <= current_acc_slot_q;
226:                         tile_clear_on_drain <= 1'b1;
227: 
228:                         // Chuyển sang slot tích lũy tiếp theo trong Latch Array
229:                         if (n_tile_cnt_q < csr_tile_n_q - 1'b1) begin
230:                             n_tile_cnt_q       <= n_tile_cnt_q + 1'b1;
231:                             current_acc_slot_q <= current_acc_slot_q + 1'b1;
232:                         end else begin
233:                             // Hoàn thành toàn bộ ma trận!
234:                             is_busy_q <= 1'b0;
235:                             is_done_q <= 1'b1;
236:                         end
237:                     end
238:                 end
239:             end
240:         end
241:     end

243:     // =========================================================================
244:     // PHẦN 4: KHỞI TẠO CORE TÍNH TOÁN (snax_fused_llm_core)
245:     // =========================================================================
246:     snax_fused_llm_core #(

281: 
282:     // Softmax accepts a drained score only when the P FIFO can take the
283:     // resulting block.  The shell must also gate tile_drain_req_i with
284:     // p_fifo_almost_full_o so the raw score is not lost.
285:     //
286:     // The drain region matters as well: while the sequencer drains the previous
287:     // group's O accumulator during the next group's QK, cfg_mode is still 2'b01
288:     // but those words are output vectors, not scores.  Only S-slot drains
289:     // (index >= ACC_DEPTH/2) may enter softmax.
290:     logic drain_is_o_q;
291:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
292:         if (!rst_n) drain_is_o_q <= 1'b0;
293:         else if (tile_drain_req_i) drain_is_o_q <= ~tile_drain_idx_i[SLOT_AW-1];
294:     end
295: 
296:     wire sm_in_valid = (cfg_mode_i == 2'b01) && raw_drained_valid &&
297:                        !p_fifo_almost_full && !drain_is_o_q;
298: 
299:     // Pipeline registers to isolate LN2 multiplier from softmax_requantizer
300:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][31:0] score_for_softmax_q;
301:     logic                                sm_in_valid_q;
302:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0]              cfg_key_mask_q;
303: 
304:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
305:         if (!rst_n) begin
306:             sm_in_valid_q       <= 1'b0;
307:             cfg_key_mask_q      <= '0;
308:             score_for_softmax_q <= '0;
309:         end else begin
310:             sm_in_valid_q  <= sm_in_valid;
311:             cfg_key_mask_q <= cfg_key_mask_i;
312:             if (sm_in_valid) begin
313:                 score_for_softmax_q <= score_for_softmax;
314:             end
315:         end
316:     end
317: 
318:     softmax_requantizer #(
319:         .BLOCK_SIZE  (NUM_LANES_P),
320:         .SCORE_FRAC  (FRAC_BITS),
321:         .NUM_QUERIES (NUM_QUERIES)
322:     ) u_softmax_requantizer (
323:         .clk           (clk),
324:         .rst_n         (rst_n),
325:         .in_valid      (sm_in_valid_q),
326:         .score_in      (score_for_softmax_q),
327:         .key_mask      (cfg_key_mask_q),
328:         .row_start     (row_start_d1),
329:         .clear         (1'b0),
330:         .query_idx     (sm_query_idx_d1),
331:         .out_valid     (sm_out_valid),
332:         .code_out      (sm_code_out),
333:         .p_blk_out     (sm_p_blk_out),
334:         .csum_out      (),
335:         .l_contrib_out (sm_l_contrib_out),
336:         .block_empty   (),
337:         .m_valid       (sm_m_valid),
338:         .m_out         (sm_m_out),
339:         .row_start_out (),
340:         .resc_valid    (sm_resc_valid),
341:         .resc_q        (sm_resc_q),
342:         .resc_r        (sm_resc_r)
343:     );
344: 
345:     // Delay the rescale sideband by one cycle to align with sm_out_valid
346:     // (softmax latency 1 -> 2).  This is the factor carried by the P block.
347:     logic                 sm_resc_valid_d1;
348:     logic signed [7:0]    sm_resc_q_d1;
349:     logic        [2:0]    sm_resc_r_d1;
350:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
351:         if (!rst_n) begin
352:             sm_resc_valid_d1 <= 1'b0;
353:             sm_resc_q_d1     <= 8'sd0;
354:             sm_resc_r_d1     <= 3'd0;
355:         end else begin
356:             sm_resc_valid_d1 <= sm_resc_valid;
357:             sm_resc_q_d1     <= sm_resc_q;
358:             sm_resc_r_d1     <= sm_resc_r;
359:         end
360:     end
361: 
362:     // O is rescaled when the corresponding P block is consumed, using the
363:     // sideband stored with that P block.  The matmul registers this sideband
364:     // through Stage 1 so Stage 2 applies it with the P product.
365:     assign acc_rescale_req = (cfg_mode_i == 2'b10) &&
366:                              compute_fire && !p_fifo_empty &&
367:                              p_fifo_resc_valid;
368:     assign resc_q          = p_fifo_resc_q;
369:     assign resc_r          = p_fifo_resc_r;
370: 
371:     // =========================================================================
372:     // 4. TRANSIENT P_FIFO (Đệm vòng chứa gói xác suất P 72-bit)
373:     // =========================================================================
374:     // P packet (72b) + rescale sideband (12b): {valid, q[7:0], r[2:0]}.
375:     wire [P_FIFO_W-1:0] p_packet_wdata = {
376:         sm_query_idx_d3,
377:         sm_resc_valid_d1,
378:         sm_resc_q_d1,
379:         sm_resc_r_d1,
380:         sm_p_blk_out,
381:         sm_code_out
382:     };
383: 
384:     // Consume a P block only on a real compute beat, never on an empty FIFO.
385:     assign p_fifo_pop = (cfg_mode_i == 2'b10) &&
386:                         compute_fire && !p_fifo_empty;
387: 
388:     p_fifo #(
389:         .DATA_WIDTH (P_FIFO_W),
390:         .DEPTH      (P_FIFO_DEPTH)
391:     ) u_p_fifo (
392:         .clk     (clk),
393:         .rst_n   (rst_n),
394:         .clear   (drain_is_row_start_q && (sm_query_idx == '0)),
395:         .push    (sm_out_valid),
396:         .wdata   (p_packet_wdata),
397:         .full    (p_fifo_full),
398:         .pop     (p_fifo_pop),
399:         .rdata   (p_fifo_rdata),
400:         .empty   (p_fifo_empty),
401:         .count   (p_fifo_count)
402:     );
403: 
404:     // =========================================================================
405:     // 5. BỘ TÍCH LŨY MẪU SỐ VÀ SINH NGHỊCH ĐẢO 1/L (l_accumulator)
406:     // =========================================================================
407:     logic [15:0] inv_l_mant;
408:     logic [4:0]  inv_l_exp;
409:     logic        l_accum_ready;
410: 
411:     assign l_ready_o = l_accum_ready;
412: 
413:     logic [NUM_QUERIES-1:0][15:0] inv_l_mant_q;
414:     logic [NUM_QUERIES-1:0][4:0]  inv_l_exp_q;
415: 
416:     l_accumulator #(
417:         .SCORE_FRAC  (FRAC_BITS),
418:         .NUM_QUERIES (NUM_QUERIES)
419:     ) u_l_accumulator (
420:         .clk            (clk),
421:         .rst_n          (rst_n),
422:         .query_idx      (sm_query_idx_d3),
423:         .row_start      (row_start_d3),
424:         .clear          (1'b0),
425:         .l_valid        (sm_out_valid),
426:         .resc_valid     (sm_resc_valid_d1),
427:         .resc_q         (sm_resc_q_d1),
428:         .resc_r         (sm_resc_r_d1),
429:         .l_contrib_in   (sm_l_contrib_out),
430:         .l_total_out    (),
431:         .l_ready        (l_accum_ready),
432:         .inv_l_mant     (inv_l_mant),
433:         .inv_l_exp      (inv_l_exp),
434:         .inv_l_mant_q   (inv_l_mant_q),
435:         .inv_l_exp_q    (inv_l_exp_q)
436:     );
437: 
438:     // =========================================================================
439:     // 6. KHỐI CHUẨN HÓA ĐẦU RA (final_normalizer)
440:     // =========================================================================
441:     logic                      norm_drain_req;
442:     logic                      norm_bypass_inv_l;
443:     logic                      norm_vec_valid;
444:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][15:0] norm_vec_lanes;
445:     logic [NUM_LANES_P*16-1:0] norm_vec_packed;
446: 
447:     // Ở mode P*V (10), cần nhân với 1/l (bypass = 0). Ở mode GEMM chuẩn (00), bỏ qua 1/l (bypass = 1).
448:     //
449:     // The normalizer is qualified by the DRAIN REGION, not by the operating
450:     // mode.  An O-slot drain (index 0..ACC_DEPTH/2-1) is always normalized:
451:     // that is what lets the sequencer keep draining the previous group's O
452:     // accumulator while the next group's QK fills the S slots, which happens in
453:     // attention mode.  An S-slot drain feeds softmax and must not come here.
454:     assign norm_drain_req    = raw_drained_valid &&
455:                                ((cfg_mode_i == 2'b10) || drain_is_o_q);
456:     assign norm_bypass_inv_l = (cfg_mode_i == 2'b00);
457: 
458:     // The O-drain slot selects which query's reciprocal is used.
459:     logic [QW-1:0] norm_query;
460:     logic [15:0]   norm_inv_l_mant;
461:     logic [4:0]    norm_inv_l_exp;
462:     assign norm_query      = drain_query_idx;
463:     assign norm_inv_l_mant = inv_l_mant_q[norm_query];
464:     assign norm_inv_l_exp  = inv_l_exp_q[norm_query];
465: 
466:     final_normalizer #(
467:         .NUM_LANES_P (NUM_LANES_P),
468:         .FRAC_BITS   (FRAC_BITS)
469:     ) u_final_normalizer (
470:         .clk          (clk),
471:         .rst_n        (rst_n),
472:         .drain_req    (norm_drain_req),
473:         .bypass_inv_l (norm_bypass_inv_l),
474:         .accum_in     (score_array),
475:         .inv_l_mant   (norm_inv_l_mant),
476:         .inv_l_exp    (norm_inv_l_exp),
477:         .vec_valid    (norm_vec_valid),
478:         .vec_out      (norm_vec_lanes),
479:         .vec_packed   (norm_vec_packed)
480:     );
481: 
482:     logic [NUM_LANES_P*16-1:0] src_packed;
483:     logic                      src_valid;
484: 
485:     always_comb begin
486:         if (cfg_mode_i == 2'b00) begin
487:             src_packed = gemm_vec_packed;
488:             src_valid  = gemm_vec_valid;
489:         end else begin
490:             src_packed = norm_vec_packed;
491:             src_valid  = norm_vec_valid;
492:         end
493:     end
494: 
495:     // Output hold register: the FP16 vector is held until the downstream
496:     // consumer accepts it.
497:     //
498:     // NOTE: an 8-entry FIFO was tried here to let the sequencer drain the
499:     // accumulator one slot per cycle.  It produced a wrong vector for the last
500:     // slot of the last group, so it was reverted; the drain is paced by the
501:     // consumer again.  out_fifo_ready_o is kept as an always-ready stub.
502:     logic          out_hold_q;
503:     logic [NUM_LANES_P*16-1:0] out_hold_packed_q;
504: 
505:     wire out_ready = USE_OUTPUT_READY ? out_vec_fp16_ready_i : 1'b1;
506: 
507:     assign out_vec_fp16_packed_o = out_hold_q ? out_hold_packed_q : src_packed;
508:     assign out_vec_fp16_valid_o  = out_hold_q | src_valid;
509: 
510:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
511:         if (!rst_n) begin
512:             out_hold_q        <= 1'b0;
513:             out_hold_packed_q <= '0;
514:         end else if (out_vec_fp16_valid_o && !out_ready) begin
515:             out_hold_q        <= 1'b1;
516:             out_hold_packed_q <= out_vec_fp16_packed_o;
517:         end else if (out_vec_fp16_valid_o && out_ready) begin
518:             out_hold_q        <= 1'b0;
519:         end
520:     end
521: 
522:     assign out_fifo_ready_o = 1'b1;
523: 
524:     assign out_vec_fp4_packet_o = '0;
525:     assign out_vec_fp4_valid_o  = 1'b0;
526: 
527:     generate
528:         for (genvar k = 0; k < NUM_LANES_P; k++) begin : GEN_FP16_LANES
529:             assign out_vec_fp16_lanes_o[k] = out_vec_fp16_packed_o[k*16 +: 16];
530:         end
531:     endgenerate
532: 
533: endmodule

267:     // =========================================================================
268:     // 3. TẦNG BỘ NHỚ TCDM & BỘ CHUYỂN MẠCH CROSSBAR 21 MASTERS
269:     // =========================================================================
270:     // Master 0: DMA Port (DRAM <-> TCDM)
271:     assign m_req_valid[0]       = dma_mem_req_valid_i;
272:     assign m_req_addr[0]        = dma_mem_req_addr_i;
273:     assign m_req_write[0]       = dma_mem_req_write_i;
274:     assign m_req_wdata[0]       = dma_mem_req_wdata_i;
275:     assign m_req_strb[0]        = dma_mem_req_strb_i;
276:     assign dma_mem_req_ready_o  = m_req_ready[0];
277:     assign dma_mem_rsp_valid_o  = m_rsp_valid[0];
278:     assign dma_mem_rsp_rdata_o  = m_rsp_rdata[0];
279: 
280:     // Master 1: CPU RV32I Port (TCDM L1 Scratchpad Access cho RoPE/Norm/SiLU)
281:     assign m_req_valid[1]       = cpu_mem_req_valid_i;
282:     assign m_req_addr[1]        = cpu_mem_req_addr_i;
283:     assign m_req_write[1]       = cpu_mem_req_write_i;
284:     assign m_req_wdata[1]       = cpu_mem_req_wdata_i;
285:     assign m_req_strb[1]        = cpu_mem_req_strb_i;
286:     assign cpu_mem_req_ready_o  = m_req_ready[1];
287:     assign cpu_mem_rsp_valid_o  = m_rsp_valid[1];
288:     assign cpu_mem_rsp_rdata_o  = m_rsp_rdata[1];
289: 
290:     // Master 2: Activation / Q Streamer
291:     assign m_req_valid[2]       = act_m_req_valid;
292:     assign m_req_addr[2]        = act_m_req_addr;
293:     assign m_req_write[2]       = act_m_req_write;
294:     assign m_req_wdata[2]       = act_m_req_wdata;
295:     assign m_req_strb[2]        = act_m_req_strb;
296:     assign act_m_req_ready      = m_req_ready[2];
297:     assign act_m_rsp_valid      = m_rsp_valid[2];
298:     assign act_m_rsp_rdata      = m_rsp_rdata[2];
299: 
300:     // Masters 3..18: 16-Channel Weight / KV Streamer
301:     genvar gw;
302:     generate
303:         for (gw = 0; gw < 16; gw++) begin : GEN_WT_MASTERS
304:             assign m_req_valid[3+gw]  = wt_m_req_valid[gw];
305:             assign m_req_addr[3+gw]   = wt_m_req_addr[gw];
306:             assign m_req_write[3+gw]  = wt_m_req_write[gw];
307:             assign m_req_wdata[3+gw]  = wt_m_req_wdata[gw];
308:             assign m_req_strb[3+gw]   = wt_m_req_strb[gw];
309:             assign wt_m_req_ready[gw] = m_req_ready[3+gw];
310:             assign wt_m_rsp_valid[gw] = m_rsp_valid[3+gw];
311:             assign wt_m_rsp_rdata[gw] = m_rsp_rdata[3+gw];
312:         end
313:     endgenerate
314: 
315:     // Master 19: Output Write Streamer
316:     assign m_req_valid[19]      = wo_m_req_valid;
317:     assign m_req_addr[19]       = wo_m_req_addr;
318:     assign m_req_write[19]      = wo_m_req_write;
319:     assign m_req_wdata[19]      = wo_m_req_wdata;
320:     assign m_req_strb[19]       = wo_m_req_strb;
321:     assign wo_m_req_ready       = m_req_ready[19];
322: 
323:     // Master 20: TCDM FP16 Read Streamer
324:     assign m_req_valid[20]      = rd_m_req_valid;
325:     assign m_req_addr[20]       = rd_m_req_addr;
326:     assign m_req_write[20]      = rd_m_req_write;
327:     assign m_req_wdata[20]      = rd_m_req_wdata;
328:     assign m_req_strb[20]       = rd_m_req_strb;
329:     assign rd_m_req_ready       = m_req_ready[20];
330:     assign rd_m_rsp_valid       = m_rsp_valid[20];
331:     assign rd_m_rsp_rdata       = m_rsp_rdata[20];
332: 
333:     // Crossbar Interconnect
334:     interleaved_interconnect_72b #(
335:         .NUM_MASTERS   (NUM_MASTERS),
336:         .NUM_BANKS     (NUM_BANKS),
337:         .DATA_WIDTH    (DATA_WIDTH),
338:         .ADDR_WIDTH    (ADDR_WIDTH),
339:         .BANK_DEPTH    (BANK_DEPTH)
340:     ) u_interconnect (
341:         .clk           (clk),
342:         .rst_n         (rst_n),
343:         .m_req_valid_i (m_req_valid),
344:         .m_req_addr_i  (m_req_addr),
345:         .m_req_write_i (m_req_write),
346:         .m_req_wdata_i (m_req_wdata),
347:         .m_req_strb_i  (m_req_strb),
348:         .m_req_ready_o (m_req_ready),

350:         .m_rsp_rdata_o (m_rsp_rdata),
351:         .b_req_o       (b_req),
352:         .b_write_o     (b_write),
353:         .b_addr_o      (b_addr),
354:         .b_wdata_o     (b_wdata),
355:         .b_strb_o      (b_strb),
356:         .b_rdata_i     (b_rdata),
357:         .b_rvalid_i    (b_rvalid)
358:     );

360:     // Multi-bank TCDM (32 Banks)

363:         .DATA_WIDTH    (DATA_WIDTH),

373:         .bank_strb_i   (b_strb),
374:         .bank_rdata_o  (b_rdata),
375:         .bank_rvalid_o (b_rvalid)
376:     );

422:         .wt_num_tiles             (csr_wt_num_tiles),
423:         .wt_tile_step             (csr_wt_tile_step),

432:         .core_enable_slq          (csr_core_enable_slq),
433:         .core_tile_drain_req      (csr_core_tile_drain_req),
434:         .core_tile_drain_idx      (csr_core_tile_drain_idx),

447:         .seq_op_mode              (csr_seq_op_mode),

449:         .seq_enable_dma           (csr_seq_enable_dma),
450:         .seq_attn_h               (csr_seq_attn_h),

493:         .cfg_tcdm_ring_base_i  (csr_seq_tcdm_ring_base),

522:         .act_token_stride_o    (seq_act_token_stride),
523:         .act_busy_i            (act_busy),
524:         .act_valid_i           (act_stream_valid),
525:         .act_ready_o           (seq_act_ready),

570:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
571:     // Control source select: CSR (direct) vs sequencer (autonomous)
572:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
573:     assign act_start          = csr_src_sel ? csr_act_start : seq_act_start;
574:     assign act_base           = csr_src_sel ? csr_act_base : seq_act_base;
575:     assign act_k_blocks       = csr_src_sel ? csr_act_k_blocks : seq_act_k_blocks;
576:     assign act_k_stride       = csr_src_sel ? csr_act_k_stride : seq_act_k_stride;
577:     assign act_tokens         = csr_src_sel ? csr_act_tokens : seq_act_tokens;
578:     assign act_token_stride   = csr_src_sel ? csr_act_token_stride : seq_act_token_stride;
579:     assign act_stream_ready   = csr_src_sel ? csr_act_ready : seq_act_ready;
580: 
581:     assign wt_start           = csr_src_sel ? csr_wt_start : seq_wt_start;
582:     assign wt_base            = csr_src_sel ? csr_wt_base : seq_wt_base;
583:     assign wt_repeat          = csr_src_sel ? csr_wt_repeat : seq_wt_repeat;

669:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
670:     // MUX 3-to-1 CHỌN NGUỒN FP16 VÀO LOG-QUANTIZER
671:     // cfg_quant_src_sel: 2'b00: Core FP16 (GEMM/Attn Row)
672:     //                    2'b01: Transpose FP16 (V Column)
673:     //                    2'b10: Read Stream FP16 (TCDM Readback)
674:     //
675:     // The CSR selection is authoritative, except that an in-flight V batch or
676:     // readback burst overrides it: those sources are not buffered and would be
677:     // corrupted if the mux switched away mid-batch.
678:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
679:     // `rd_busy` already covers the whole readback burst: the read stream stays
680:     // busy until its last vector has been accepted, which is exactly the cycle
681:     // the mux must still select the readback source.
682:     wire src_v_sel    = v_active || (cfg_quant_src_sel == 2'b01);
683:     wire src_rd_sel   = !v_active && (rd_busy || (cfg_quant_src_sel == 2'b10));
684:     wire src_core_sel = !src_v_sel && !src_rd_sel;

686:     // Module Log-Quantizer chuẩn (Thuần túy chuyển đổi FP16 -> FP4 72b)
687:     // The quantizer exposes in_ready/out_ready, so the mux gates each source
688:     // with that signal and no external buffering is needed.
689:     always_comb begin
690:         quant_fp16_in  = core_fp16_packed;
691:         quant_in_valid = 1'b0;
692: 
693:         if (src_v_sel) begin
694:             quant_fp16_in  = trans_fp16_packed;
695:             quant_in_valid = v_col_issue;
696:         end else if (src_rd_sel) begin
697:             quant_fp16_in  = rd_fp16_data;
698:             quant_in_valid = rd_fp16_valid && quant_accept;
699:         end else if (src_core_sel) begin
700:             quant_fp16_in  = core_fp16_packed;
701:             quant_in_valid = core_fp16_valid && quant_accept && !wo_mode_fp16;
702:         end
703:     end
704: 
705:     log_quantizer #(
706:         .BLOCK_SIZE   (16),
707:         .PACKET_WIDTH (72)
708:     ) u_log_quantizer (
709:         .clk        (clk),
710:         .reset_n    (rst_n),
711:         .fp16_in    (quant_fp16_in),
712:         .in_valid   (quant_in_valid),
713:         .in_ready   (quant_accept),
714:         .packed_vec (wo_fp4_data),
715:         .out_valid  (wo_fp4_valid),
716:         .out_ready  (wo_fp4_ready)
717:     );

720:     // Readback / V / core-FP16 handshakes
721:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
722:     assign v_base        = csr_v_base;
723:     assign v_num_batches = csr_v_num_batches;

725:     assign rd_num_vectors = csr_rd_num_vectors;
726:     assign rd_line_stride = csr_rd_line_stride;

732:     // accepted here would never be taken by any downstream block.
733:     assign core_fp16_ready = v_active ? v_row_ready : wo_mode_fp16 ? wo_fp16_ready : src_core_sel ? quant_accept : 1'b0;

4: // =============================================================================
5: // vsq_matmul_engine — 16-Lane LogScale-Lazy MatMul Engine
6: //   Front-end: FP4 dot-product → log-scale split (q, r) → CSD frac scaler →
7: //              bidirectional octave shifter → 32-bit saturating RMW add
8: //   Accumulator: 1W2R latch array (write commits next cycle per two-phase
9: //              protocol; read is combinational; Port B = rolling slot drain)
10: //
11: // REQUIRED FILELIST (compiled TOGETHER):
12: //     fp4_mult_lut.sv  compressor_4to2.sv  dot_product_16.sv  latch_array.sv
13: //     vsq_matmul_engine.sv  + testbench
14: //   Do NOT co-compile with vsq_feba_core_top*.sv or vsq_pe_*.sv: they define
15: //   helper modules with the same names (logscale_lazy_drain_norm, etc.).
16: //
17: // INTERFACE CONVENTION (deliberately different from legacy vsq_feba_core_top):
18: //   - act_broadcast : ONE shared activation packet (64b FP4 + 8b exp) → all lanes
19: //   - wt_in[0:15]   : PER-LANE weight packets (16 output channels)
20: //   (legacy top was the opposite: act_in[16] + wt_broadcast)
21: //
22: // PIPELINE (2 stages — timing-relaxed, mirrors vsq_feba_core_top_latch_2r1w):
23: //   - Stage 1 (cycle T)    : dot → (q, r) → CSD scaler → shifter (feed-forward)
24: //   - Stage 1→2 registers  : lane_valid_q1 / lane_acc_idx_q1 / aligned_prod_q1
25: //   - Stage 2 (cycle T+1)  : same-cycle RMW (raddr1 == waddr == idx_q1) + write
26: //     command; commits per the latch_array two-phase protocol.
27: //   - Drain : request at Td → drain word registered (Td+1) → FP16 normalize
28: //     (combinational) → output registered (Td+2); core_vec_valid pulses at Td+2.
29: //     Rolling-drain overlap = drain request aligned with the accumulate's
30: //     STAGE-2 cycle (one cycle after its operand input), matching the legacy
31: //     golden-model semantics.

63:                 unique casez (chunk)
64:                     8'b1???????: lzc_sub[g] = 3'd0;
65:                     8'b01??????: lzc_sub[g] = 3'd1;
66:                     8'b001?????: lzc_sub[g] = 3'd2;
67:                     8'b0001????: lzc_sub[g] = 3'd3;
68:                     8'b00001???: lzc_sub[g] = 3'd4;
69:                     8'b000001??: lzc_sub[g] = 3'd5;
70:                     8'b0000001?: lzc_sub[g] = 3'd6;
71:                     8'b00000001: lzc_sub[g] = 3'd7;
72:                     default:     lzc_sub[g] = 3'd7;
73:                 endcase
74:             end
75:         end
76:     endgenerate
77: 
78:     logic [5:0] lzc;
79:     always_comb begin
80:         unique casez (sub_has_one)
81:             4'b1???: lzc = {3'd0, lzc_sub[3]};
82:             4'b01??: lzc = 6'd8  + {3'd0, lzc_sub[2]};
83:             4'b001?: lzc = 6'd16 + {3'd0, lzc_sub[1]};
84:             4'b0001: lzc = 6'd24 + {3'd0, lzc_sub[0]};
85:             default: lzc = 6'd32;
86:         endcase
87:     end
88: 
89:     logic [4:0]        msb_pos;
90:     logic signed [7:0] raw_exp;
91: 
92:     assign msb_pos = (lzc >= 6'd32) ? 5'd0 : (5'd31 - lzc[4:0]);
93:     assign raw_exp = $signed({3'b000, msb_pos}) - 8'(signed'(FRAC_BITS)) + 8'sd15;
94: 
95:     // Single-Shift Fixed-Wire Extraction
96:     logic [31:0] norm_shifted;
97:     logic [9:0]  mant_bits;
98:     logic        guard_bit, round_bit, sticky_bit;
99: 
100:     assign norm_shifted = abs_y << lzc[4:0];
101:     assign mant_bits    = norm_shifted[30:21];
102:     assign guard_bit    = norm_shifted[20];
103:     assign round_bit    = norm_shifted[19];
104:     assign sticky_bit   = |norm_shifted[18:0];
105: 
106:     logic        round_up;
107:     logic [10:0] rounded_mant;
108:     logic signed [7:0] final_exp;
109: 
110:     assign round_up     = guard_bit & (round_bit | sticky_bit | mant_bits[0]);
111:     assign rounded_mant = {1'b0, mant_bits} + {10'd0, round_up};
112:     assign final_exp    = rounded_mant[10] ? (raw_exp + 8'sd1) : raw_exp;
113: 
114:     always_comb begin
115:         if (abs_y == 32'd0 || final_exp <= 8'sd0) begin
116:             fp16_out = 16'h0000;
117:         end else if (final_exp >= 8'sd31) begin
118:             fp16_out = {fp_sign, 5'b11110, 10'h3FF};
119:         end else begin
120:             fp16_out = {fp_sign, final_exp[4:0], rounded_mant[9:0]};
121:         end
122:     end
123: 
124: endmodule
125: 
126: 
127: // =============================================================================
128: // Module: scale_adder — log-scale exponent combine (8-bit signed, eighths)
129: //   res = scale_a + scale_w;  q = floor(res/8) (octave part, signed slice);
130: //                             r = res[2:0]      (= (a+w) mod 8 residual)
131: // =============================================================================
132: module scale_adder(
133:     input  logic signed [7:0]  scale_a,
134:     input  logic signed [7:0]  scale_w,
135:     output logic signed [5:0]  q,
136:     output logic        [2:0]  r
137: );
138: 
139:     wire signed [8:0] res = scale_a + scale_w;
140:     assign q = res[8:3];
141:     assign r = res[2:0];
142: 
143: endmodule
144: 
145: 
146: // =============================================================================
147: // Module: logscale_frac_scaler — P × m_r / 32 via 3-term CSD (Q2 × Q5 = Q7)
148: //   m_r approximates 2^(r/8) as a 3-term signed power-of-2 decomposition:
149: //       r: 0    1     2     3     4     5     6     7
150: //       m: 32   35    38    41    46    49    54    59
151: //   Zero-negator arithmetic: 1's-complement terms + 2 absorbed carry-ins
152: //   (carry-vector LSB for sub_t1, final CPA carry-in for sub_t2).
153: // =============================================================================
154: module logscale_frac_scaler (
155:     input  logic signed [12:0] prod_in,      // Q2 dot-product (13-bit signed)
156:     input  logic        [2:0]  r,            // fractional exponent residual (0..7)
157:     output logic signed [18:0] scaled_prod   // Q7 = prod_in × m_r
158: );
159: 
160:     // Sign-extend 13-bit Q2 input to 19 bits
161:     logic signed [18:0] p_ext;
162:     assign p_ext = {{6{prod_in[12]}}, prod_in};
163: 
164:     // Term 0: 2-to-1 MUX (r >= 6 selects 64*P, else 32*P)
165:     logic [18:0] t0;
166:     assign t0 = (r[2] & r[1]) ? (p_ext <<< 6) : (p_ext <<< 5);
167: 
168:     // Term 1 & Term 2 magnitudes + 1's complement inversion flags
169:     logic [18:0] t1_mag, t2_mag;
170:     logic        sub_t1, sub_t2;
171: 
172:     always_comb begin
173:         unique case (r)
174:             3'd0: begin t1_mag = 19'd0;         sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = 19'd0;         sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32P
175:             3'd1: begin t1_mag = (p_ext <<< 1); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = p_ext;         sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32P + 2P + P = 35P
176:             3'd2: begin t1_mag = (p_ext <<< 2); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = (p_ext <<< 1); sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32P + 4P + 2P = 38P
177:             3'd3: begin t1_mag = (p_ext <<< 3); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = p_ext;         sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32P + 8P + P = 41P
178:             3'd4: begin t1_mag = (p_ext <<< 4); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = (p_ext <<< 1); sub_t2 = 1'b1; end // 32P + 16P - 2P = 46P
179:             3'd5: begin t1_mag = (p_ext <<< 4); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = p_ext;         sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32P + 16P + P = 49P
180:             3'd6: begin t1_mag = (p_ext <<< 3); sub_t1 = 1'b1; t2_mag = (p_ext <<< 1); sub_t2 = 1'b1; end // 64P - 8P - 2P = 54P
181:             3'd7: begin t1_mag = (p_ext <<< 2); sub_t1 = 1'b1; t2_mag = p_ext;         sub_t2 = 1'b1; end // 64P - 4P - P = 59P
182:         endcase
183:     end
184: 
185:     logic [18:0] t1, t2;
186:     assign t1 = sub_t1 ? (~t1_mag) : t1_mag;
187:     assign t2 = sub_t2 ? (~t2_mag) : t2_mag;
188: 
189:     // Single 19-bit 3:2 Carry-Save Adder (1 Full-Adder delay, zero carry ripple)
190:     logic [18:0] csa_sum, csa_cout;
191:     assign csa_sum  = t0 ^ t1 ^ t2;
192:     assign csa_cout = (t0 & t1) | (t1 & t2) | (t0 & t2);
193: 
194:     // Inject sub_t1 into bit 0 of the left-shifted carry vector
195:     logic [18:0] csa_carry_shifted;
196:     assign csa_carry_shifted = {csa_cout[17:0], sub_t1};
197: 
198:     // Final 19-bit CPA with sub_t2 as carry-in
199:     assign scaled_prod = $signed(csa_sum + csa_carry_shifted + 19'(sub_t2));
200: 
201: endmodule
202: 
203: 
204: // =============================================================================
205: // Module: bidirectional_shifter — Q7 (19b) × 2^net_shift, net_shift = q + (FRAC-7)
206: //   net_shift ≥ 0 : left shift, 34-bit intermediate, 32-bit signed saturation
207: //   net_shift < 0 : narrow (19-bit) arithmetic right shift + sign-extend
208: //   Bit-exact with the golden model (gen_vsq_patterns.py lazy_stage1_fe):
209: //   same zero / right / >+15-saturate / else-wide branch order.
210: // =============================================================================
211: module bidirectional_shifter #(
212:     parameter int FRAC_BITS = 16
213: )(
214:     input  logic signed [18:0] scaled_prod,      // Q7 product (from CSD scaler)
215:     input  logic signed [5:0]  q,                // octave exponent floor((a+w)/8)
216:     output logic signed [31:0] aligned_prod_32   // Q(32-FRAC_BITS).FRAC_BITS aligned product (saturated)
217: );
218: 
219:     localparam int BASE_SHIFT = FRAC_BITS - 7;   // Q7 → Q18 alignment (+11 for 18)
220: 
221:     logic signed [6:0] net_shift;
222:     assign net_shift = $signed({q[5], q}) + 7'(signed'(BASE_SHIFT));
223: 
224:     logic [3:0]         lshift_amt;
225:     logic [4:0]         rshift_amt;
226:     logic signed [33:0] lshifted_wide;
227:     logic signed [18:0] rshifted_narrow;
228: 
229:     // Magnitude-checked saturation helpers for net_shift in [16, 25] — constant-
230:     // threshold form (reviewer proposal; bit-exact with the previous form):
231:     //   W = scaled_prod << (net_shift-16)  =>  aligned = W * 2^16 must fit int32:
232:     //     positive overflow : W >= +2^15  (any bit of W[32:15] set, W positive)
233:     //     negative overflow : W <  -2^15  (upper bits not all ones, W negative)
234:     //   (replaces the 2^(31-net_shift) comparator + its 34-bit negation)
235:     logic signed [33:0] wide16;
236:     logic               sat_pos_hi;
237:     logic               sat_neg_hi;
238: 
239:     assign lshift_amt      = net_shift[3:0];
240:     assign rshift_amt      = (-net_shift > 7'sd19) ? 5'd19 : unsigned'(-net_shift[4:0]);
241:     assign lshifted_wide   = 34'(scaled_prod) <<< lshift_amt;
242:     assign rshifted_narrow = scaled_prod >>> rshift_amt;
243: 
244:     assign wide16     = 34'(scaled_prod) <<< net_shift[3:0];   // scaled*2^(net-16), net 16..25
245:     assign sat_pos_hi = ~wide16[33] & (|wide16[32:15]);
246:     assign sat_neg_hi =  wide16[33] & ~(&wide16[32:15]);
247: 
248:     always_comb begin
249:         if (scaled_prod == 19'sd0) begin
250:             aligned_prod_32 = 32'sd0;
251:         end else if (net_shift < 7'sd0) begin
252:             aligned_prod_32 = {{13{rshifted_narrow[18]}}, rshifted_narrow};
253:         end else if (net_shift > 7'sd15) begin
254:             // Bit-exact magnitude-checked saturation (matches golden lazy_stage1_fe):
255:             //   * net >= 26 : |scaled_prod| >= 32 always overflows -> saturate
256:             //   * net 16..25: |W| >= 2^15 overflows (constant-threshold reduce);
257:             //     +2^31 saturates, -2^31 is representable and passes through
258:             if (net_shift >= 7'sd26) begin
259:                 aligned_prod_32 = scaled_prod[18] ? 32'sh8000_0000 : 32'sh7FFF_FFFF;
260:             end else if (sat_pos_hi) begin
261:                 aligned_prod_32 = 32'sh7FFF_FFFF;
262:             end else if (sat_neg_hi) begin
263:                 aligned_prod_32 = 32'sh8000_0000;
264:             end else begin
265:                 aligned_prod_32 = {wide16[15:0], 16'd0};
266:             end
267:         end else begin
268:             if (lshifted_wide > 34'sd2147483647) begin
269:                 aligned_prod_32 = 32'sh7FFF_FFFF;
270:             end else if (lshifted_wide < -34'sd2147483648) begin
271:                 aligned_prod_32 = 32'sh8000_0000;
272:             end else begin
273:                 aligned_prod_32 = lshifted_wide[31:0];
274:             end
275:         end
276:     end
277: 
278: endmodule
279: 
280: 
281: // =============================================================================
282: // Module: accum_adder — 32-bit saturating signed adder (sat_add32)
283: // =============================================================================
284: module accum_adder (
285: 
286:     input logic signed [31:0]  a, 
287:     input logic signed [31:0]  b,   
288:     output logic signed [31:0] sum
289: 
290: ); 
291: 
292:     function automatic logic signed [31:0] sat_add32(
293:         input logic signed [31:0] a,
294:         input logic signed [31:0] b
295:     );
296:         logic signed [32:0] s;
297:         begin
298:             s = $signed({a[31], a}) + $signed({b[31], b});
299:             if (s > 33'sd2147483647)       sat_add32 = 32'sh7FFF_FFFF;
300:             else if (s < -33'sd2147483648) sat_add32 = 32'sh8000_0000;
301:             else                           sat_add32 = s[31:0];
302:         end
303:     endfunction
304: 
305:     assign sum = sat_add32(a, b); 
306: 
307: endmodule
308: 
309: 
310: // =============================================================================
311: // Module: vsq_matmul_engine
312: // =============================================================================
313: module vsq_matmul_engine #(
314:     parameter int NUM_LANES_P = NUM_LANES,        
315:     parameter int ACC_DEPTH_P = ACCUMULATOR_DEPTH,   
316:     parameter int PKT_W       = PACKET_WIDTH,      // 72 bits (64b FP4 + 8b Exp)
317:     parameter int FRAC_BITS   = 16                
318: )
319: (
320:     input logic                            clk, 
321:     input logic                            reset_n, 
322: 
323:     input  logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0]         lane_valid_in,
324:     input  logic [$clog2(ACC_DEPTH_P)-1:0] lane_acc_idx,             // Current accumulation slot
325:     input  logic [PKT_W-1:0]               act_broadcast,            // Shared Act vector broadcast
326:     input  logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][PKT_W-1:0] wt_in,  // Per-lane Weight vectors
327: 
328:     // Drain & Tile Control (Supports Simultaneous Compute & Rolling Drain)
329:     input  logic                           tile_drain_req,
330:     input  logic [$clog2(ACC_DEPTH_P)-1:0] tile_drain_acc_idx,       // Slot to drain across all lanes
331:     input  logic                           tile_clear_on_drain,
332: 
333:     // Online Rescale Interface (for FlashAttention O-accumulator)
334:     input  logic                           acc_rescale_req,
335:     input  logic signed [7:0]              resc_q,
336:     input  logic [2:0]                     resc_r,
337: 
338:     // Direct Raw 32-bit Score Output (for Softmax Requantizer Bypass)
339:     output logic [NUM_LANES_P*32-1:0]      raw_drained_word,
340:     output logic                           raw_drained_valid,
341: 
342:     // Final FP16 Vector Scaled Output (256-bit SIMD / 16 x FP16)
343:     output logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][15:0]  core_vec_out,
344:     output logic [NUM_LANES_P*16-1:0]      core_vec_packed,
345:     output logic                           core_vec_valid
346: );
347: 
348:     localparam int TOTAL_W = NUM_LANES_P * 32;   // 512 bits per slot
349:     localparam int SLOT_AW = $clog2(ACC_DEPTH_P);
350: 
351:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
352:     // STAGE 1 (cycle T): per-lane front-end
353:     //   dot → (q, r) split → CSD frac scaler → bidirectional shifter
354:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
355:     int mm_l_s1a;
356:     int mm_l_s1b;
357:     int mm_l_out;
358: 
359:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][15:0] dot_out_array;
360:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][5:0]  q_array;
361:     logic        [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][2:0]  r_array;
362:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][18:0] scaled_prod;
363:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][31:0] fe_aligned_prod;
364: 
365:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
366:     // Stage 1A -> Stage 1B pipeline registers (Dot-product & Scale adder output)
367:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
368:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0]              lane_valid_s1a;
369:     logic [SLOT_AW-1:0]                  lane_acc_idx_s1a;
370:     logic                                acc_rescale_req_s1a;
371:     logic signed [7:0]                   resc_q_s1a;
372:     logic        [2:0]                   resc_r_s1a;
373:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][15:0] dot_out_q1;
374:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][5:0]  q_array_q1;
375:     logic        [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][2:0]  r_array_q1;
376: 
377:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
378:         if (!reset_n) begin
379:             lane_valid_s1a      <= '0;
380:             lane_acc_idx_s1a    <= '0;
381:             acc_rescale_req_s1a <= 1'b0;
382:             resc_q_s1a          <= 8'sd0;
383:             resc_r_s1a          <= 3'd0;
384:             for (mm_l_s1a = 0; mm_l_s1a < NUM_LANES_P; mm_l_s1a++) begin
385:                 dot_out_q1[mm_l_s1a] <= 16'sd0;
386:                 q_array_q1[mm_l_s1a] <= 6'sd0;
387:                 r_array_q1[mm_l_s1a] <= 3'd0;
388:             end
389:         end else begin
390:             lane_valid_s1a      <= lane_valid_in;
391:             lane_acc_idx_s1a    <= lane_acc_idx;
392:             acc_rescale_req_s1a <= acc_rescale_req;
393:             resc_q_s1a          <= resc_q;
394:             resc_r_s1a          <= resc_r;
395:             for (mm_l_s1a = 0; mm_l_s1a < NUM_LANES_P; mm_l_s1a++) begin
396:                 if (lane_valid_in[mm_l_s1a]) begin
397:                     dot_out_q1[mm_l_s1a] <= dot_out_array[mm_l_s1a];
398:                     q_array_q1[mm_l_s1a] <= q_array[mm_l_s1a];
399:                     r_array_q1[mm_l_s1a] <= r_array[mm_l_s1a];
400:                 end
401:             end
402:         end
403:     end
404: 
405:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
406:     // Stage 1B -> Stage 2 pipeline registers (Aligned product & RMW setup)
407:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
408:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0] lane_valid_q1;
409:     logic [SLOT_AW-1:0]     lane_acc_idx_q1;
410:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][31:0] aligned_prod_q1;
411: 
412:     // Online-rescale sideband travels with the P block through Stage 1 so
413:     // Stage 2 rescales the O accumulator in the same cycle it adds the P
414:     // product.  The core drives these directly from the P-FIFO head.
415:     logic                   acc_rescale_req_q1;
416:     logic signed [7:0]      resc_q_q1;
417:     logic        [2:0]      resc_r_q1;
418: 
419:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
420:         if (!reset_n) begin
421:             lane_valid_q1      <= '0;
422:             lane_acc_idx_q1    <= '0;
423:             acc_rescale_req_q1 <= 1'b0;
424:             resc_q_q1          <= 8'sd0;
425:             resc_r_q1          <= 3'd0;
426:             for (mm_l_s1b = 0; mm_l_s1b < NUM_LANES_P; mm_l_s1b++) begin
427:                 aligned_prod_q1[mm_l_s1b] <= 32'sd0;
428:             end
429:         end else begin
430:             lane_valid_q1      <= lane_valid_s1a;
431:             lane_acc_idx_q1    <= lane_acc_idx_s1a;
432:             acc_rescale_req_q1 <= acc_rescale_req_s1a;
433:             resc_q_q1          <= resc_q_s1a;
434:             resc_r_q1          <= resc_r_s1a;
435:             for (mm_l_s1b = 0; mm_l_s1b < NUM_LANES_P; mm_l_s1b++) begin
436:                 if (lane_valid_s1a[mm_l_s1b]) begin
437:                     aligned_prod_q1[mm_l_s1b] <= fe_aligned_prod[mm_l_s1b];
438:                 end
439:             end
440:         end
441:     end
442: 
443:     wire any_lane_valid_q1 = |lane_valid_q1;
444: 
445:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
446:     // STAGE 2 (cycle T+1): 32-bit saturating RMW add + latch-array write command
447:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
448:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][31:0] old_res;
449:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][31:0] new_res;
450: 
451:     logic [TOTAL_W-1:0] wdata, rdata1, rdata2;
452: 
453:     // Virtual clear mask (`slot_cleared` semantics, identical to legacy top):
454:     //   SET on reset / drain-with-clear; CLEARED when Stage 2 commits.
455:     logic [ACC_DEPTH_P-1:0] slot_cleared;
456: 
457:     genvar i;
458:     generate 
459:         for (i = 0; i < NUM_LANES_P; i++) begin: GEN_MAC_LANE
460:             dot_product_16 u_dot_product_16(
461:                 .act_vec        (act_broadcast[63:0]),
462:                 .wt_vec         (wt_in[i][63:0]),
463:                 .dot_out        (dot_out_array[i])
464:             );
465: 
466:             scale_adder u_scale_adder(
467:                 .scale_a    (signed'(act_broadcast[71:64])),
468:                 .scale_w    (signed'(wt_in[i][71:64])),
469:                 .q          (q_array[i]),
470:                 .r          (r_array[i])
471:             );  
472: 
473:             logscale_frac_scaler u_logscale_frac_scaler(
474:                 .prod_in            (signed'(dot_out_q1[i][12:0])),
475:                 .r                  (r_array_q1[i]),
476:                 .scaled_prod        (scaled_prod[i])
477:             ); 
478: 
479:             bidirectional_shifter #(.FRAC_BITS(FRAC_BITS))
480:             u_bidirectional_shifter (
481:                 .scaled_prod        (scaled_prod[i]),
482:                 .q                  (q_array_q1[i]),
483:                 .aligned_prod_32    (fe_aligned_prod[i])
484:             );
485: 
486:             // Stage-2 RMW: old accumulator (masked if slot is 'cleared')
487:             assign old_res[i] = slot_cleared[lane_acc_idx_q1] ? 32'sd0
488:                                                        : signed'(rdata1[i*32 +: 32]);
489: 
490:             logic signed [31:0] rescaled_old_res;
491:             logic signed [31:0] effective_old_res;
492: 
493:             vsq_rescaler_32b u_rescaler (
494:                 .val_in     (old_res[i]),
495:                 .resc_q     (resc_q_q1),
496:                 .resc_r     (resc_r_q1),
497:                 .scaled_out (rescaled_old_res)
498:             );
499: 
500:             assign effective_old_res = acc_rescale_req_q1 ? rescaled_old_res : old_res[i];
501: 
502:             accum_adder u_accum_adder(
503:                 .a         (aligned_prod_q1[i]),  
504:                 .b         (effective_old_res),  
505:                 .sum       (new_res[i]) 
506:             );
507: 
508:             // Per-lane gating: invalid lanes write back their (masked) effective old value
509:             assign wdata[i*32 +: 32] = lane_valid_q1[i] ? new_res[i] : effective_old_res;
510:         end 
511:     endgenerate
512: 
513:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
514:     // 1-Write 2-Read Latch Array RMW Accumulator
515:     //   Port A: same-cycle RMW read (raddr1 == waddr)
516:     //   Port B: rolling slot drain read
517:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
518:     latch_array #(
519:         .DEPTH (ACC_DEPTH_P),
520:         .DW    (TOTAL_W)
521:     ) u_latch_array (
522:         .clk                (clk),

4: // in0 + in1 + in2 + in3 + cin = sum + 2 * (carry + cout)
5: module compressor_4to2 (

19:     assign xor_0123 = xor_012 ^ in3;
20:     assign sum      = xor_0123 ^ cin;
21:     assign carry    = (xor_0123 & cin) | (~xor_0123 & in3);

2: // =============================================================================
3: // Module: softmax_requantizer
4: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
5: // Exp-free probability generator for the FP4 attention path.
6: //
7: // Consumes one block of BLOCK_SIZE attention scores straight out of the matmul
8: // accumulator and produces the P operand for the following P*V matmul:
9: //
10: //   code_out      BLOCK_SIZE x E2M1 magnitude codes (probabilities, sign = 0)
11: //   p_blk_out     one Log8 S4.3 block scale
12: //   csum_out      sum of M_int = 2*|level|, this block's contribution to l
13: //   l_contrib_out S_blk * csum in Q16
14: //   resc_*        factor 2^(m_old - m_new) for the online rescale of O and l
15: //
16: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
17: // WHY THERE IS NO exp
18: //
19: //   softmax :  p_t = E_t / l,   E_t = 2^(s_t - m),   l = sum_u E_u
20: //   FP4 scale:  S = max(p) / 6 = E_bmax / (6 l)
21: //
22: //   The quantiser encodes p_t / S, and p_t and S carry the same 1/l:
23: //
24: //       p_t / S = (E_t / l) / (E_bmax / (6 l)) = 6 * E_t / E_bmax
25: //               = 6 * 2^-(s_bmax - s_t) = 6 * 2^-d_t
26: //
27: //   l and m cancel, so the code depends only on d_t, a plain integer
28: //   subtraction. Rounding 6*2^-d_t to the nearest E2M1 level therefore becomes
29: //   a comparison of d_t against seven constants: the arithmetic midpoints of
30: //   E2M1 pushed through d = log2(6 / beta).
31: //
32: //   The unnormalised convention S = E_bmax / 6 is used because l is unknown
33: //   until the whole row has been consumed. l is accumulated from the quantised
34: //   codes and folded into the final output scale by the consumer.
35: //
36: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
37: // TIMING (one block per cycle, back to back)
38: //
39: //   latency 1 : m_out / m_valid / row_start_out / resc_*
40: //       The running max is fed back to the next block, so its loop must close
41: //       in one cycle. The 16-input max tree is therefore combinational on the
42: //       input side.
43: //
44: //   latency 2 : code_out / p_blk_out / csum_out / l_contrib_out / block_empty
45: //       One more register stage for subtract + threshold + CSD scale.
46: //
47: //   If the max tree cannot close timing, register half of it and add one cycle
48: //   to BOTH paths; the block rate must then drop accordingly.
49: //
50: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
51: // INVARIANTS
52: //   * p_blk_out <= -21 always, because s_bmax - m <= 0 by construction.
53: //   * a masked key gets code 0 and contributes nothing to csum or the max tree.
54: //   * on row_start_out the consumer must CLEAR (not scale) O and l.
55: //   * BLOCK_SIZE is fixed at 16: the max tree is a 4-level 8-4-2-1 reduction.
56: // =============================================================================
57: module softmax_requantizer #(
58:     parameter int BLOCK_SIZE  = 16,  // fixed at 16 (see INVARIANTS)
59:     parameter int SCORE_FRAC  = 16,  // scores are Q16 two's complement
60:     parameter int NUM_QUERIES = 1,
61:     parameter int QW = (NUM_QUERIES > 1) ? $clog2(NUM_QUERIES) : 1
62: ) (
63:     input  logic                        clk,
64:     input  logic                        rst_n,
65: 
66:     // ---------------------------------------------------------- score block
67:     input  logic                        in_valid,
68:     input  logic signed [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][31:0] score_in,
69:     input  logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0]       key_mask,     // 1 = key visible
70:     input  logic                        row_start,    // first block of a row
71:     input  logic                        clear,        // reset ALL query maxima
72:     input  logic [QW-1:0]               query_idx,    // query state select
73: 
74:     // ------------------------------------------------------- P operand (lat 2)
75:     output logic                        out_valid,
76:     output logic [4*BLOCK_SIZE-1:0]     code_out,     // per key: {1'b0, mag[2:0]}
77:     output logic signed [7:0]           p_blk_out,    // Log8 S4.3 block scale
78:     output logic [7:0]                  csum_out,     // sum of M_int = 2*|level|
79:     output logic signed [31:0]          l_contrib_out,// S_blk * csum in Q16
80:     output logic                        block_empty,  // no visible key
81: 
82:     // ------------------------------------- online max / rescale (latency 1)
83:     output logic                        m_valid,
84:     output logic signed [31:0]          m_out,        // updated running max
85:     output logic                        row_start_out,
86:     output logic                        resc_valid,   // running max increased
87:     output logic signed [7:0]           resc_q,       // octave part of 2^(dm)
88:     output logic        [2:0]           resc_r        // CSD residual index
89: );
90: 
91:     // =========================================================================
92:     // 1. Constants
93:     // =========================================================================
94:     // Seven E2M1 arithmetic-midpoint boundaries, expressed as the distance
95:     // d = log2(6 / beta) in Q16.  A key with d <= TH[k] gets the k-th code.
96:     //
97:     //   beta  6.0/4.0  4.0/3.0  3.0/2.0  2.0/1.5  1.5/1.0  1.0/0.5  0.5/0.0
98:     //   d     0.2630   0.7776   1.2630   1.7776   2.2630   3.0000   4.5850
99:     //   Q16   17238    50961    82774    116497   148310   196608   300480
100:     localparam logic [32:0] TH_6P0 = 33'd17238;
101:     localparam logic [32:0] TH_4P0 = 33'd50961;
102:     localparam logic [32:0] TH_3P0 = 33'd82774;
103:     localparam logic [32:0] TH_2P0 = 33'd116497;
104:     localparam logic [32:0] TH_1P5 = 33'd148310;
105:     localparam logic [32:0] TH_1P0 = 33'd196608;
106:     localparam logic [32:0] TH_0P5 = 33'd300480;
107: 
108:     // 8*log2(6) = 20.68, rounded to 21.  The constant is identical for every
109:     // block, so it cancels exactly in the consumer's O/l normalisation; only
110:     // the fractional part of p_blk matters.
111:     localparam logic signed [32:0] P_OFFSET = -33'sd21;
112: 
113:     // Rounding term for p = 8*(s_bmax - m)/2^SCORE_FRAC, i.e. half an LSB of
114:     // the shift below.  Rounding halves the scale error versus truncation
115:     // (4.4% -> 2.2% RMS) and can only make the scale larger, which is the safe
116:     // direction (no clipping).
117:     localparam logic signed [32:0] P_RND = 33'sd1 << (SCORE_FRAC - 4);
118: 
119:     // CSD approximation of 32 * 2^(r/8), identical to logscale_frac_scaler.
120:     localparam logic [5:0] CSD_Q5 [0:7] = '{6'd32, 6'd35, 6'd38, 6'd41,
121:                                            6'd46, 6'd49, 6'd54, 6'd59};
122: 
123:     // Most negative signed value: used to make masked keys lose the max tree.
124:     localparam logic signed [31:0] S_MIN = 32'sh8000_0000;
125: 
126:     // =========================================================================
127:     // 2. Helper functions
128:     // =========================================================================
129:     // Nearest E2M1 magnitude for a normalised value 6*2^-d.  Because the value
130:     // decreases monotonically with d, this is a pure threshold function.
131:     function automatic logic [2:0] mag_of(input logic [32:0] d);
132:         if      (d <= TH_6P0) mag_of = 3'b111;   // 6.0
133:         else if (d <= TH_4P0) mag_of = 3'b110;   // 4.0
134:         else if (d <= TH_3P0) mag_of = 3'b101;   // 3.0
135:         else if (d <= TH_2P0) mag_of = 3'b100;   // 2.0
136:         else if (d <= TH_1P5) mag_of = 3'b011;   // 1.5
137:         else if (d <= TH_1P0) mag_of = 3'b010;   // 1.0
138:         else if (d <= TH_0P5) mag_of = 3'b001;   // 0.5
139:         else                  mag_of = 3'b000;   // 0.0
140:     endfunction
141: 
142:     // M_int = 2 * |level|, the same encoding fp4_mult_lut uses.  Summing M_int
143:     // instead of the level keeps the row sum integral; the factor 2 is a
144:     // constant and cancels in the consumer's O/l.
145:     function automatic logic [3:0] mint_of(input logic [2:0] mag);
146:         case (mag)
147:             3'd0:    mint_of = 4'd0;    // 0.0
148:             3'd1:    mint_of = 4'd1;    // 0.5
149:             3'd2:    mint_of = 4'd2;    // 1.0
150:             3'd3:    mint_of = 4'd3;    // 1.5
151:             3'd4:    mint_of = 4'd4;    // 2.0
152:             3'd5:    mint_of = 4'd6;    // 3.0
153:             3'd6:    mint_of = 4'd8;    // 4.0
154:             default: mint_of = 4'd12;   // 6.0
155:         endcase
156:     endfunction
157: 
158:     // =========================================================================
159:     // 3. Stage 0 (combinational): causal mask + 16-input max tree
160:     // =========================================================================
161:     logic signed [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][31:0] score_msk;
162:     logic               any_valid;
163: 
164:     int sm_t_msk;
165:     int sm_t_s1;
166:     int sm_t_code;
167:     int sm_t_out;
168:     int sm_i;
169:     int sm_q;

171:     always_comb begin
172:         for (sm_t_msk = 0; sm_t_msk < BLOCK_SIZE; sm_t_msk++)
173:             score_msk[sm_t_msk] = key_mask[sm_t_msk] ? score_in[sm_t_msk] : S_MIN;
174:         any_valid = |key_mask;
175:     end

177:     logic signed [7:0][31:0] tree_l1;
178:     logic signed [3:0][31:0] tree_l2;
179:     logic signed [1:0][31:0] tree_l3;
180:     logic signed [31:0] blk_max;
181: 
182:     always_comb begin
183:         for (sm_i = 0; sm_i < 8; sm_i++)
184:             tree_l1[sm_i] = ($signed(score_msk[2*sm_i]) > $signed(score_msk[2*sm_i+1])) ? score_msk[2*sm_i] : score_msk[2*sm_i+1];
185:         for (sm_i = 0; sm_i < 4; sm_i++)
186:             tree_l2[sm_i] = ($signed(tree_l1[2*sm_i]) > $signed(tree_l1[2*sm_i+1])) ? tree_l1[2*sm_i] : tree_l1[2*sm_i+1];
187:         for (sm_i = 0; sm_i < 2; sm_i++)
188:             tree_l3[sm_i] = ($signed(tree_l2[2*sm_i]) > $signed(tree_l2[2*sm_i+1])) ? tree_l2[2*sm_i] : tree_l2[2*sm_i+1];
189:         blk_max = ($signed(tree_l3[0]) > $signed(tree_l3[1])) ? tree_l3[0] : tree_l3[1];
190:     end
191: 
192:     // =========================================================================
193:     // 4. Running max and rescale factor (one-cycle loop)
194:     // =========================================================================
195:     logic signed [NUM_QUERIES-1:0][31:0] m_q;
196:     logic signed [31:0] m_curr;
197:     logic signed [31:0] m_next;
198:     logic               resc_req;
199: 
200:     assign m_curr = m_q[query_idx];
201: 
202:     always_comb begin
203:         if (!any_valid) begin
204:             m_next   = m_curr;                    // empty block: hold
205:             resc_req = 1'b0;
206:         end else if (row_start) begin
207:             m_next   = blk_max;                   // new row: reload
208:             resc_req = 1'b0;
209:         end else begin
210:             m_next   = (blk_max > m_curr) ? blk_max : m_curr;
211:             resc_req = (blk_max > m_curr);

213:     end

215:     // c = 2^(m_old - m_new) with m_old - m_new <= 0, split into an octave part
216:     // and a 3-bit CSD residual so the consumer reuses logscale_frac_scaler.
217:     logic signed [32:0] resc_delta;               // <= 0
218:     logic signed [32:0] resc_oct;
219:     logic signed [7:0]  resc_q_d;
220:     logic        [2:0]  resc_r_d;
221: 
222:     assign resc_delta = {m_curr[31], m_curr} - {m_next[31], m_next};
223:     assign resc_oct   = resc_delta >>> SCORE_FRAC;
224: 
225:     always_comb begin
226:         if      (resc_oct < -33'sd128) resc_q_d = -8'sd128;
227:         else if (resc_oct >  33'sd127) resc_q_d =  8'sd127;
228:         else                           resc_q_d =  resc_oct[7:0];
229:         resc_r_d = resc_delta[SCORE_FRAC-1 -: 3];
