232:     // =========================================================================
233:     // 5. Stage 1 registers
234:     // =========================================================================
235:     logic signed [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][31:0] s1_score;
236:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0] s1_mask;
237:     logic signed [31:0]    s1_blk_max;
238:     logic signed [31:0]    s1_m;          // m_next of this block
239:     logic                  s1_valid;
240:     logic                  s1_row_start;
241:     logic                  s1_any;
242: 
243:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
244:         if (!rst_n) begin
245:             for (sm_q = 0; sm_q < NUM_QUERIES; sm_q++) m_q[sm_q] <= S_MIN;
246:             s1_valid     <= 1'b0;
247:             s1_row_start <= 1'b0;
248:             s1_any       <= 1'b0;
249:             s1_mask      <= '0;
250:             s1_blk_max   <= S_MIN;
251:             s1_m         <= S_MIN;
252:             for (sm_t_s1 = 0; sm_t_s1 < BLOCK_SIZE; sm_t_s1++) s1_score[sm_t_s1] <= 32'sd0;
253:         end else begin
254:             // `clear` resets every query's running max at once, which is what
255:             // lets the drain run one block per cycle.  Clearing to S_MIN makes
256:             // the very first block of each query take max(S_MIN, blk_max) =
257:             // blk_max on the normal path, so no per-block seed pulse is needed.
258:             if (clear) begin
259:                 for (sm_q = 0; sm_q < NUM_QUERIES; sm_q++) m_q[sm_q] <= S_MIN;
260:             end else if (in_valid) begin
261:                 m_q[query_idx] <= m_next;
262:             end
263:             s1_valid     <= in_valid;
264:             s1_row_start <= in_valid & row_start;
265:             s1_any       <= in_valid & any_valid;
266:             s1_mask      <= in_valid ? key_mask : '0;
267:             s1_blk_max   <= blk_max;
268:             s1_m         <= m_next;
269:             for (sm_t_s1 = 0; sm_t_s1 < BLOCK_SIZE; sm_t_s1++) s1_score[sm_t_s1] <= score_msk[sm_t_s1];
270:         end
271:     end
272: 
273:     // =========================================================================
274:     // 6. Stage 2 (combinational): scale, codes, code sum, l contribution
275:     // =========================================================================
276:     // 6a. Block scale:  p = 8*log2(S_blk) = 8*(s_bmax - m)/2^SCORE_FRAC - 8*log2(6)
277:     logic signed [32:0] blk_max_minus_m;
278:     logic signed [32:0] p_wide;
279:     logic signed [7:0]  p_blk;
280: 
281:     assign blk_max_minus_m = {s1_blk_max[31], s1_blk_max} - {s1_m[31], s1_m};
282: 
283:     always_comb begin
284:         p_wide = ((blk_max_minus_m + P_RND) >>> (SCORE_FRAC - 3)) + P_OFFSET;
285:         if      (p_wide < -33'sd128) p_blk = -8'sd128;
286:         else if (p_wide >  33'sd127) p_blk =  8'sd127;
287:         else                         p_blk =  p_wide[7:0];
288:     end
289: 
290:     // 6b. Per-key distance, magnitude, code and code sum
291:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][32:0] score_dist;
292:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][2:0]  mag;
293:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][3:0]  code_d;
294:     logic [7:0]  csum_d;
295: 
296:     always_comb begin
297:         csum_d = 8'd0;
298:         for (sm_t_code = 0; sm_t_code < BLOCK_SIZE; sm_t_code++) begin
299:             score_dist[sm_t_code]   = {s1_blk_max[31], s1_blk_max} - {s1_score[sm_t_code][31], s1_score[sm_t_code]};
300:             mag[sm_t_code]    = mag_of(score_dist[sm_t_code]);
301:             code_d[sm_t_code] = s1_mask[sm_t_code] ? {1'b0, mag[sm_t_code]} : 4'b0000;
302:             csum_d    = csum_d + (s1_mask[sm_t_code] ? {4'd0, mint_of(mag[sm_t_code])} : 8'd0);
303:         end
304:     end
305: 
306:     // 6c. l contribution: S_blk * sum(level) * 2^SCORE_FRAC
307:     //     csum_d is 2*sum(level) (the M_int encoding used by fp4_mult_lut),
308:     //     so the final shift is 6 instead of 5.  This removes the extra
309:     //     factor 2 that would otherwise make O/l half of the true softmax
310:     //     average.  S_blk = 2^(p/8) = 2^q * CSD[r]/32 with q = p>>>3, r = p&7.
311:     logic signed [7:0]  q_s;
312:     logic        [2:0]  r_s;
313:     logic        [14:0] prod;
314:     logic        [4:0]  sh;
315:     logic signed [31:0] l_contrib;
316: 
317:     always_comb begin
318:         q_s  = p_blk >>> 3;                     // [-16, 15]
319:         r_s  = p_blk[2:0];                      // p mod 8, always non-negative
320:         prod = csum_d * CSD_Q5[r_s];            // <= 192*59
321:         sh   = q_s[4:0] + 5'(SCORE_FRAC);       // q + SCORE_FRAC (0..13 in range)
322:         if (sh > 5'd15) sh = 5'd15;             // defensive: unreachable while p<=-21
323:         if (sh >= 5'd6) l_contrib = 32'(prod) << (sh - 5'd6);
324:         else            l_contrib = 32'(prod) >> (5'd6 - sh);
325:     end
326: 
327:     // =========================================================================
328:     // 7. Output registers
329:     // =========================================================================
330:     // latency 1: must be available before the next block starts
331:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
332:         if (!rst_n) begin
333:             m_valid       <= 1'b0;
334:             m_out         <= S_MIN;
335:             row_start_out <= 1'b0;
336:             resc_valid    <= 1'b0;
337:             resc_q        <= 8'sd0;
338:             resc_r        <= 3'd0;
339:         end else begin
340:             m_valid       <= in_valid & any_valid;
341:             m_out         <= m_next;
342:             row_start_out <= in_valid & row_start;
343:             resc_valid    <= in_valid & any_valid & resc_req;
344:             resc_q        <= resc_q_d;
345:             resc_r        <= resc_r_d;
346:         end
347:     end
348: 
349:     // latency 2: the P operand
350:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
351:         if (!rst_n) begin
352:             out_valid     <= 1'b0;
353:             code_out      <= '0;
354:             p_blk_out     <= 8'sd0;
355:             csum_out      <= 8'd0;
356:             l_contrib_out <= 32'sd0;
357:             block_empty   <= 1'b0;
358:         end else begin
359:             out_valid   <= s1_valid;
360:             block_empty <= s1_valid & ~s1_any;
361:             if (s1_valid) begin
362:                 for (sm_t_out = 0; sm_t_out < BLOCK_SIZE; sm_t_out++)
363:                     code_out[4*sm_t_out +: 4] <= code_d[sm_t_out];
364:                 p_blk_out     <= p_blk;
365:                 csum_out      <= csum_d;
366:                 l_contrib_out <= l_contrib;
367:             end
368:         end
369:     end
370: 
371: endmodule

1: // =============================================================================
2: // Module: log_quantizer  (bản viết tay của bạn — chỉ sửa lỗi, giữ nguyên cấu trúc)
3: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
4: //   16 x FP16  ->  PACKET_WIDTH-bit packet = { scale_log8[7:0], fp4[15:0] }
5: //   Giải mã: value_i = sign_i * E2M1[mag_i] * 2^(scale_log8/8)
6: // =============================================================================
7: module log_quantizer #(
8:     parameter BLOCK_SIZE = 16,
9:     parameter PACKET_WIDTH = 72
10: ) (
11:     input logic                          clk,
12:     input logic                          reset_n,
13: 
14:     input logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][15:0]   fp16_in,
15:     input logic                          in_valid,
16:     output logic                         in_ready,
17: 
18:     output logic [PACKET_WIDTH-1:0]      packed_vec,
19:     output logic                         out_valid,
20:     input logic                          out_ready
21: );
22: 
23:     localparam signed [9:0]  SCALE_OFFSET = 9'sd140;
24: 
25:     // [FIX] 7 ngưỡng diff còn thiếu (trung điểm giữa các mức FP4, đơn vị 1/8 octave)
26:     localparam logic [7:0] TH_6P0 = 8'd2;
27:     localparam logic [7:0] TH_4P0 = 8'd6;
28:     localparam logic [7:0] TH_3P0 = 8'd10;
29:     localparam logic [7:0] TH_2P0 = 8'd14;
30:     localparam logic [7:0] TH_1P5 = 8'd18;
31:     localparam logic [7:0] TH_1P0 = 8'd24;
32:     localparam logic [7:0] TH_0P5 = 8'd36;   // biên 0.25 -> 8*log2(6/0.25) = 36.7
33: 
34:     // [FIX] thiếu return type; không được khai báo wire trong function
35:     function automatic logic [7:0] max2 (input logic [7:0] a, b);
36:         return (a > b) ? a : b;
37:     endfunction
38: 
39:     // Mã biên độ FP4 E2M1 từ số nấc thấp hơn đỉnh.
40:     function automatic logic [2:0] fp4_mag_of(input logic [7:0] diff);
41:         if      (diff <= TH_6P0) return 3'b111;  // 6.0
42:         else if (diff <= TH_4P0) return 3'b110;  // 4.0
43:         else if (diff <= TH_3P0) return 3'b101;  // 3.0
44:         else if (diff <= TH_2P0) return 3'b100;  // 2.0
45:         else if (diff <= TH_1P5) return 3'b011;  // 1.5
46:         else if (diff <= TH_1P0) return 3'b010;  // 1.0
47:         else if (diff <= TH_0P5) return 3'b001;  // 0.5
48:         else                     return 3'b000;  // 0.0
49:     endfunction
50: 
51: 
52:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][4:0] E_fp16;
53:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][9:0] M_fp16;
54:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0]      sign_fp16;   // [FIX] logoc -> logic
55: 
56:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][7:0] mu;
57:     logic [7:0]                 mu_max;
58:     int                         slq_i_tree;
59:     int                         slq_i_seq;
60:     int                         slq_i_diff;
61:     int                         slq_i_out;
62: 
63:     generate
64:         // [FIX] generate loop cần genvar (không dùng int)
65:         for (genvar i=0; i<BLOCK_SIZE; i++) begin
66:             // [FIX] phải index [i] vào từng phần tử
67:             assign E_fp16[i]    = fp16_in[i][14:10];
68:             assign M_fp16[i]    = fp16_in[i][9:0];
69:             assign sign_fp16[i] = fp16_in[i][15];
70: 
71:             assign mu[i]        = (E_fp16[i] == 5'd0)  ? 8'd0   :
72:                                   (E_fp16[i] == 5'd31) ? 8'd247 :
73:                                                          {E_fp16[i], M_fp16[i][9:7]};
74:         end
75:     endgenerate
76: 
77: 
78:     // COMPARATION TREE
79:     logic [7:0][7:0] level1;
80:     logic [3:0][7:0] level2;
81:     logic [1:0][7:0] level3;
82: 
83:     always_comb begin
84:         for (slq_i_tree=0;slq_i_tree<8;slq_i_tree++) begin
85:              level1[slq_i_tree] = max2(mu[2*slq_i_tree], mu[2*slq_i_tree+1]);
86:         end
87:         for (slq_i_tree=0;slq_i_tree<4;slq_i_tree++) begin
88:              level2[slq_i_tree] = max2(level1[2*slq_i_tree], level1[2*slq_i_tree+1]);
89:         end
90:         for (slq_i_tree=0;slq_i_tree<2;slq_i_tree++) begin
91:              level3[slq_i_tree] = max2(level2[2*slq_i_tree], level2[2*slq_i_tree+1]);
92:         end
93:         mu_max = level3[0] > level3[1] ? level3[0]  : level3[1] ;
94:     end
95: 
96:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][7:0] mu_d1;
97:     logic [7:0]                 mu_max_q1;
98:     logic [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0]      sign_fp16_q1;
99:     logic                       in_valid_q1;
100: 
101:     // Both pipeline stages share one stall: the output register is the only
102:     // elastic element, so the pipe can advance whenever it is free.  Exposing
103:     // this as `in_ready` turns the quantizer into a normal handshake stage
104:     // instead of an open pipe that silently drops packets under backpressure.
105:     wire pipe_advance = !out_valid || out_ready;
106:     assign in_ready   = pipe_advance;
107: 
108:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
109:         if (!reset_n) begin
110:             mu_max_q1 <= 'd0;
111:             sign_fp16_q1 <= 'd0;
112:             in_valid_q1 <= 1'b0;
113:             for (slq_i_seq=0; slq_i_seq<BLOCK_SIZE;slq_i_seq++) mu_d1[slq_i_seq] <= 'd0;
114:         end
115:         else if (pipe_advance) begin
116:             in_valid_q1 <= in_valid;
117:             if (in_valid) begin
118:                 mu_max_q1    <= mu_max;
119:                 sign_fp16_q1 <= sign_fp16;
120:                 for (slq_i_seq=0; slq_i_seq<BLOCK_SIZE;slq_i_seq++) mu_d1[slq_i_seq] <= mu[slq_i_seq];
121:             end
122:         end
123:     end
124: 
125:     logic signed  [8:0] scale_raw ;
126:     logic signed  [7:0] scale_sat ;
127: 
128:     always_comb begin
129:         // [FIX] zero-check phải dùng mu_max_q1 (cùng tầng với phép trừ);
130:         //       tách if/else để nhánh zero không bị ghi đè
131:         if (mu_max_q1 == 8'd0) begin
132:             scale_sat = 8'sd0;
133:         end else begin
134:             // [FIX] zero-extend + $signed để tránh trộn signed/unsigned
135:             scale_raw = $signed({1'b0, mu_max_q1}) - SCALE_OFFSET;
136:             // [FIX] biên clamp đúng: 127 / -128 (8'sh80)
137:             if      (scale_raw >  9'sd127) scale_sat = 8'sd127;
138:             else if (scale_raw < -9'sd128) scale_sat = 8'sh80;
139:             else                           scale_sat = scale_raw[7:0];
140:         end
141:     end
142: 
143:     // DIFF CODE COMPUTING
144:     logic  [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][7:0] diff_code;
145:     logic  [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][3:0] fp4_code;
146:     logic  [BLOCK_SIZE-1:0][2:0] mag;
147: 
148:     always_comb begin
149:         for (slq_i_diff=0; slq_i_diff<BLOCK_SIZE; slq_i_diff++) begin
150:             
151:             diff_code[slq_i_diff] = mu_max_q1 - mu_d1[slq_i_diff];
152: 
153:             // [FIX] phần tử zero/quá nhỏ phải ra +0 (tránh -0); ngược lại ghép bit dấu
154:             mag[slq_i_diff] = (mu_d1[slq_i_diff] == 8'd0 || mu_max_q1 == 8'd0) ? 3'b000
155:                                                           : fp4_mag_of(diff_code[slq_i_diff]);
156:             fp4_code[slq_i_diff] = (mag[slq_i_diff] == 3'b000) ? 4'b0000 : {sign_fp16_q1[slq_i_diff], mag[slq_i_diff]};
157:         end
158:     end
159: 
160:     always_ff @(posedge  clk or negedge reset_n) begin
161:         if (!reset_n) begin
162:             out_valid <= 1'b0;
163:             packed_vec <= 'd0;
164:         end
165:         else if (pipe_advance) begin
166:             out_valid <= in_valid_q1;
167:             // [FIX] chỉ đóng gói khi có dữ liệu hợp lệ
168:             if (in_valid_q1) begin
169:                 for (slq_i_out=0; slq_i_out<BLOCK_SIZE; slq_i_out++) begin
170:                     // [FIX] mỗi mã 4-bit, không phải 16-bit
171:                     packed_vec[4*slq_i_out +: 4] <= fp4_code[slq_i_out];
172:                 end
173:                 packed_vec[PACKET_WIDTH-1 -: 8] <= scale_sat;
174:             end
175:         end
176:     end
177: 
178: endmodule

3: // =============================================================================
4: // Module: l_accumulator
5: // Description: Per-query running denominator accumulator and reciprocal LUT
6: //              for online FlashAttention.
7: //
8: // Each query has its own l_q[q].  row_start / l_valid / resc_* apply to the
9: // query selected by query_idx.  The final normalizer reads the per-query
10: // reciprocal array and selects it by the O-drain slot.
11: // =============================================================================
12: module l_accumulator #(
13:     parameter int SCORE_FRAC  = 16,
14:     parameter int NUM_QUERIES = 1,
15:     parameter int QW = (NUM_QUERIES > 1) ? $clog2(NUM_QUERIES) : 1
16: )(
17:     input  logic                 clk,
18:     input  logic                 rst_n,
19: 
20:     // Control from softmax_requantizer / FSM
21:     input  logic [QW-1:0]        query_idx,
22:     input  logic                 row_start,
23:     input  logic                 clear,          // reset ALL query denominators
24:     input  logic                 l_valid,        // Valid block contribution
25:     input  logic                 resc_valid,     // Running max increased
26:     input  logic signed [7:0]    resc_q,         // Octave shift (<= 0)
27:     input  logic        [2:0]    resc_r,         // CSD residual index [0..7]
28:     input  logic signed [31:0]   l_contrib_in,   // Block contribution in Q16
29: 
30:     // Running accumulated denominator
31:     output logic signed [31:0]   l_total_out,
32:     output logic                 l_ready,
33: 
34:     // Selected-query reciprocal (backward-compatible single outputs)
35:     output logic [15:0]          inv_l_mant,
36:     output logic [4:0]           inv_l_exp,
37: 
38:     // Per-query reciprocals for the final normalizer
39:     output logic [NUM_QUERIES-1:0][15:0] inv_l_mant_q,
40:     output logic [NUM_QUERIES-1:0][4:0]  inv_l_exp_q
41: );

3: // =============================================================================
4: // Module: final_normalizer
5: // Description: Multiplies unnormalized accumulator vector O_unnorm by inv_l = 1/l
6: //              and converts the 16 lanes into IEEE 754 FP16 (256-bit SIMD vector).
7: //              Includes bypass mode for standard GeMM operations.
8: // =============================================================================
9: module final_normalizer #(
10:     parameter int NUM_LANES_P = 16,
11:     parameter int FRAC_BITS   = 16
12: )(
13:     input  logic                 clk,
14:     input  logic                 rst_n,
15: 
16:     input  logic                 drain_req,
17:     input  logic                 bypass_inv_l,   // 1: Standard GeMM (skip 1/l); 0: Attention (multiply 1/l)
18:     input  logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][31:0] accum_in,
19:     input  logic [15:0]          inv_l_mant,     // Reciprocal mantissa (Q15)
20:     input  logic [4:0]           inv_l_exp,      // Exponent from LZC
21: 
22:     output logic                 vec_valid,
23:     output logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][15:0] vec_out,
24:     output logic [NUM_LANES_P*16-1:0] vec_packed
25: );
26: 
27:     int fn_l;
28: 
29:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][31:0] norm_input;
30:     logic [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][15:0]        fp16_lanes;
31: 
32:     // Stage 1 Pipeline Registers (Multiplier + Saturation Result)
33:     logic signed [NUM_LANES_P-1:0][31:0] s1_norm_data_q;
34:     logic                                s1_valid_q;
35: 
36:     genvar i;
37:     generate
38:         for (i = 0; i < NUM_LANES_P; i++) begin : GEN_LANE_NORM
39:             // Stage 1 Multiplier: 32-bit signed * 16-bit unsigned
40:             logic signed [47:0] raw_mult;
41:             logic signed [63:0] raw_mult_64;
42:             logic signed [63:0] scaled_wide;
43:             logic signed [31:0] scaled_div_l;
44: 
45:             always_comb begin
46:                 raw_mult = $signed(accum_in[i]) * $signed({1'b0, inv_l_mant});
47:                 raw_mult_64 = $signed(raw_mult);
48: 
49:                 // inv_l_mant = 2^15/(1+f), inv_l_exp = leading-zero count (lzc).
50:                 // 1/l = inv_l_mant * 2^(lzc-29).  For a Q16.16 accumulator
51:                 // this is a right shift by (29-lzc), or a left shift if the
52:                 // row denominator is very small (lzc > 29).
53:                 if (inv_l_exp <= 5'd29)
54:                     scaled_wide = raw_mult_64 >>> (5'd29 - inv_l_exp);
55:                 else
56:                     scaled_wide = raw_mult_64 <<< (inv_l_exp - 5'd29);
57: 
58:                 // Saturate to the 32-bit Q16.16 accumulator range.
59:                 if (scaled_wide > 64'sd2147483647)
60:                     scaled_div_l = 32'sh7FFF_FFFF;
61:                 else if (scaled_wide < -64'sd2147483648)
62:                     scaled_div_l = 32'sh8000_0000;
63:                 else
64:                     scaled_div_l = scaled_wide[31:0];
65:             end
66: 
67:             assign norm_input[i] = bypass_inv_l ? accum_in[i] : scaled_div_l;
68: 
69:             // Stage 2: IEEE 754 FP16 Conversion from Stage 1 registered data
70:             logscale_lazy_drain_norm #(
71:                 .FRAC_BITS (FRAC_BITS)
72:             ) u_drain_norm (
73:                 .norm_in  (s1_norm_data_q[i]),
74:                 .fp16_out (fp16_lanes[i])
75:             );
76: 
77:             assign vec_packed[i*16 +: 16] = vec_out[i];
78:         end
79:     endgenerate
80: 
81:     // Stage 1 Pipeline Register Update
82:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
83:         if (!rst_n) begin
84:             s1_valid_q     <= 1'b0;
85:             s1_norm_data_q <= '0;
86:         end else begin
87:             s1_valid_q <= drain_req;
88:             if (drain_req) begin
89:                 s1_norm_data_q <= norm_input;
90:             end
91:         end
92:     end
93: 
94:     // Stage 2 Output Registers
95:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
96:         if (!rst_n) begin
97:             vec_valid <= 1'b0;
98:             for (fn_l = 0; fn_l < NUM_LANES_P; fn_l++) begin
99:                 vec_out[fn_l] <= 16'h0000;
100:             end
101:         end else begin
102:             vec_valid <= s1_valid_q;
103:             if (s1_valid_q) begin
104:                 for (fn_l = 0; fn_l < NUM_LANES_P; fn_l++) begin
105:                     vec_out[fn_l] <= fp16_lanes[fn_l];
106:                 end
107:             end
108:         end
109:     end
110: 
111: endmodule

3: // =============================================================================
4: // Cell implementations (two versions of the `icg_cell` / `dlatch` cells):
5: //
6: // - Default (macros undefined): behavioral models -> RTL simulation.
7: // - ASAP7 synthesis: compile with +define+IGC_CELL +define+LATCH_CELL to swap
8: //   in the real ASAP7 standard cells:
9: //       icg_cell -> ICGx4_ASAP7_75t_R   (GCLK,ENA,SE,CLK - SE tied to 0)
10: //       dlatch   -> DHLx2_ASAP7_75t_R   (transparent-high D-latch: Q,D,CLK)
11: //   ASAP7 (RVT flavor) sources in lib/ASAP7/:
12: //       verilog: verilog/asap7sc7p5t_SEQ_RVT_TT_220101.v          (sim)
13: //       liberty: lib/asap7sc7p5t_SEQ_RVT_{TT,SS,FF}_nldm_*.lib     (DC/Genus)
14: //       lef    : lef/asap7sc7p5t_28_R_1x_220121a.lef               (PnR)
15: //   Other drive strengths available: DHLx1/x3, ICGx1..x8(+DC); switch VT flavor
16: //   by replacing the "_R" suffix and linking the L/SLVT views.
17: // =============================================================================

23: `ifdef IGC_CELL
24: // ASAP7 structural implementation (synthesis)
25: module icg_cell (
26:     input  clk,

28:     output gclk
29: );
30:     (* dont_touch = "true" *) ICGx4_ASAP7_75t_R u_icg (
31:         .GCLK (gclk),
32:         .ENA  (en),
33:         .SE   (1'b0),   // scan enable: tie 0 (no scan path on this array)
34:         .CLK  (clk)

39: module icg_cell (
40:     input  clk, 
41:     input  en,
42:     output gclk
43: ); 
44:     logic en_q; 
45:     always@(*) begin 
46:         if (~clk) en_q = en;
47:     end
48:

86: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
87: // D flip-flop: rising-edge triggered, asynchronous active-low reset.
88: // Used when `USE_FF = 1` in `latch_array`. The clock input is the ICG-gated
89: // clock, so an inactive column simply sees no edge and holds its value.
90: //
91: // Synthesis note: the asynchronous reset requires a DFF cell that exposes a
92: // reset pin, e.g. ASAP7 `DFFASRHQx2_ASAP7_75t_R` (Q, D, CLK, RESET_B, SET_B)
93: // with SET_B tied high. Swap the body below for that cell when targeting a
94: // standard-cell library; `DFFHQx*` has no reset pin and cannot be used as-is.
95: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
96: module dff (
97:     input  logic clk,
98:     input  logic rst_n,
99:     input  logic d,
100:     output logic q
101: );
102:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
103:         if (!rst_n) q <= 1'b0;

109: // =============================================================================
110: // Module: latch_array
111: // Description: 2R1W standard-cell Latch Array (DEPTH words x DW bits, binary addr).
112: //   Word bits are split into groups of ICG_GROUP: one ICG cell per group so a
113: //   single ICG never drives more than ICG_GROUP latch CLK pins (ASAP7 ICGx4
114: //   GCLK max_capacitance = 92.16 fF; DHLx2 CLK pin = 0.474 fF => 512 loads =
115: //   242.9 fF would violate by 2.6x; 32 loads = 15.2 fF with large margin).
116: //
117: // Timing contract:
118: // - Write: command presented in cycle N is registered at posedge N+1 and
119: //   committed during cycle N+1 (addressed column's latches are transparent
120: //   while clk == 1 and close at the following negedge). The new value is
121: //   visible on both read ports starting at posedge N+1.
122: // - Read: both read ports are purely combinational.
123: // - Reset: reset_n clears the whole array to 0 through the ICG enable path
124: //   (requires clk running while reset_n is low). wdata_q resets asynchronously.
125: //
126: // Usage constraints:
127: // - wen / waddr / wdata must be cycle-stable (driven by FFs of the same clock
128: //   domain): the address decode is sampled by the ICG during clk == 0 and
129: //   wdata is captured at posedge clk.
130: // - DEPTH = number of words (power of 2 recommended); AW = $clog2(DEPTH) is
131: //   the binary address width ([AW-1:0]).
132: //
133: // STORAGE IMPLEMENTATION SELECT (`USE_FF`, elaboration-time):
134: //   USE_FF = 1'b0 : transparent-high D-latch (`DHLx2_ASAP7_75t_R`) + ICG  (default)
135: //   USE_FF = 1'b1 : rising-edge D flip-flop (`DFFHQx2_ASAP7_75t_R`)   + ICG
136: //   Both variants are CYCLE-EQUIVALENT from the outside:
137: //     * a write command presented in cycle N is captured at the posedge that
138: //       starts cycle N+1 and is observable on rdata1/rdata2 during cycle N+1;
139: //     * reads are combinational (same cycle);
140: //     * when raddr == waddr the read returns the OLD word (read-before-write),
141: //       because the write is only committed at the end of the cycle.
142: //   The FF variant captures the combinational `wdata` directly (there is no
143: //   `wdata_q` retiming stage), which is what preserves the same 1-cycle write
144: //   latency and therefore the same same-cycle RMW behaviour used by
145: //   `vsq_matmul_engine` (which additionally bypasses the finishing slot through
146: //   `drain_word_comb`).
147: //   Note for FPGA/mapping: the FF variant reads a DEPTH:1 mux per bit, so it is
148: //   intended for simulation, formal and FF-based (non-SRAM) builds. For a
149: //   distributed-RAM mapping apply `(* ram_style = "distributed" *)` on
150: //   `q_store` in the target flow.
151: // =============================================================================
152: module latch_array #( 
153:     parameter DEPTH = 16,               // number of words (2^k recommended)
154:     parameter DW    = 32,               // word width in bits
155:     parameter ICG_GROUP = 32,           // max cell CLK pins driven by one ICG cell
156:     parameter bit USE_FF = 1'b0,        // 0: D-latch (DHL), 1: D flip-flop (DFF)
157:     localparam AW   = $clog2(DEPTH),    // binary address width
158:     localparam NUM_ICG = (DW + ICG_GROUP - 1) / ICG_GROUP
159: ) (
160:     input logic                 clk, 
161:     input logic                 reset_n,
162: 
163:     input logic [AW-1:0]        waddr, 
164:     input logic [DW-1:0]        wdata, 
165:     input logic                 wen, 
166:     input logic                 ren1,
167:     input logic                 ren2, 
168:     input logic [AW-1:0]        raddr1, 
169:     input logic [AW-1:0]        raddr2, 
170:     output logic [DW-1:0]       rdata1, 
171:     output logic [DW-1:0]       rdata2
172: );  
173: 
174:     logic  [DEPTH-1:0][DW-1:0]      q_store;      // shared storage array
175:     logic  [DEPTH-1:0]              en_col;       // per-word write enable
176:     logic  [DEPTH-1:0][NUM_ICG-1:0] gclk_col;     // per-word, per-group gated clock
177:     int    la_i;
178: 
179:     // NOTE: the open-source simulator does not evaluate level-sensitive
180:     // inferred latches driven by gate-level ICG cells cycle-accurately, so a
181:     // build with that tool silently diverges from Questa and from silicon.
182:     // It also dislikes the per-bit cell netlist performance-wise, so that tool
183:     // gets a plain behavioural array with identical cycle behaviour: the word
184:     // is committed on the posedge that starts the next cycle, exactly like the
185:     // latch and DFF variants.
186: `ifdef VERILATOR
187:   `ifdef LATCH_ARRAY_FF
188:     // Opt back into the per-bit cell netlist (useful to cross-check the model).
189:     localparam bit USE_FF_EFF = 1'b1;
190:     localparam bit USE_MODEL  = 1'b0;
191:   `else
192:     localparam bit USE_FF_EFF = 1'b0;
193:     localparam bit USE_MODEL  = 1'b1;
194:   `endif
195: `else
196:     localparam bit USE_FF_EFF = USE_FF;
197:     localparam bit USE_MODEL  = 1'b0;
198: `endif
199: 
200:     // =========================================================================
201:     // Storage implementation (elaboration-time select, see header)
202:     // =========================================================================
203:     generate
204:         if (USE_MODEL) begin : gen_model_storage
205:             // -----------------------------------------------------------------
206:             // Behavioural array: one wide register per word instead of DW
207:             // single-bit cells.  Functionally identical to the DFF variant.
208:             // -----------------------------------------------------------------
209:             always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
210:                 if (!reset_n) begin

212:                 end else if (wen) begin

214:                 end

221:             //     `wdata`, so the word is committed at the posedge that starts
222:             //     the next cycle (same latency as the latch version).
223:             //   - reset is asynchronous (inside `dff`), so the address decode
224:             //     does not need the `~reset_n` term.
225:             // -----------------------------------------------------------------
226:             always_comb begin

228:                     en_col[la_i] = wen & (waddr == AW'(la_i));

244:                                 .rst_n  (reset_n),
245:                                 .d      (wdata[g*ICG_GROUP + j]),
246:                                 .q      (q_store[i][g*ICG_GROUP + j])
247:                             );
248:                         end
249:                     end
250:                 end
251:             end
252: 
253:         end else begin : gen_latch_storage

255:             // Transparent-high D-latch implementation (original)
256:             // -----------------------------------------------------------------
257:             logic [DW-1:0] wdata_q;

1: // =============================================================================
2: // Module: interleaved_interconnect_72b.sv
3: // Description: Multi-Master to 32-Bank Interleaved Crossbar Interconnect (DW=72)
4: //              - Kết nối N Masters (Host, Act Streamer, 16x Weight Channels) với 32 Banks
5: //              - Phân xử tranh chấp Round-Robin độc lập cho từng Bank
6: //              - Theo dõi phản hồi đọc theo đường ống 1 chu kỳ (Zero-Deadlock)
7: // =============================================================================
8: `timescale 1ns/1ps
9: 
10: module round_robin_arb_n #(
11:     parameter int unsigned NUM_REQS = 18
12: )(
13:     input  logic                  clk,
14:     input  logic                  rst_n,
15:     input  logic [NUM_REQS-1:0]   req_i,
16:     output logic [NUM_REQS-1:0]   grant_o
17: );
18: 
19:     logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] mask_q, mask_d;
20:     logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] masked_req;
21:     logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] unmasked_grant, masked_grant;
22: 
23:     assign masked_req     = req_i & mask_q;
24:     assign masked_grant   = masked_req & ~(masked_req - 1'b1);
25:     assign unmasked_grant = req_i & ~(req_i - 1'b1);
26: 
27:     assign grant_o = (|masked_req) ? masked_grant : unmasked_grant;
28: 
29:     always_comb begin
30:         mask_d = mask_q;
31:         if (|grant_o) begin
32:             mask_d = ~(grant_o | (grant_o - 1'b1));
33:         end
34:     end
35: 
36:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
37:         if (!rst_n) begin
38:             mask_q <= '1;
39:         end else begin
40:             mask_q <= mask_d;
41:         end
42:     end
43: 
44: endmodule
45: 
46: 
47: module interleaved_interconnect_72b #(
48:     parameter int unsigned NUM_MASTERS   = 18,   // Master 0: Host/DMA, 1: Act, 2..17: 16x Weights
49:     parameter int unsigned HOST_MASTER   = 0,    // lowest-priority (DMA) master index
50:     parameter logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0] HOST_MASK = '0, // extra low-priority masters
51:     parameter int unsigned NUM_BANKS     = 32,   // 32 SRAM Banks
52:     parameter int unsigned DATA_WIDTH    = 72,   // 72 bits
53:     parameter int unsigned ADDR_WIDTH    = 32,   // 32-bit Address
54:     parameter int unsigned BANK_DEPTH    = 1024,
55:     parameter int unsigned BYTE_OFFSET_W = 4,    // 16-byte alignment per 72b packet slot
56:     localparam int unsigned BANK_SEL_W   = $clog2(NUM_BANKS), // 5 bits
57:     localparam int unsigned BANK_ADDR_W  = $clog2(BANK_DEPTH),
58:     localparam int unsigned STRB_WIDTH   = 9
59: )(
60:     input  logic                                    clk,
61:     input  logic                                    rst_n,
62: 
63:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
64:     // Masters Interface (Host, Streamers)
65:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
66:     input  logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                  m_req_valid_i,
67:     output logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                  m_req_ready_o,
68:     input  logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]  m_req_addr_i,
69:     input  logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                  m_req_write_i,
70:     input  logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  m_req_wdata_i,
71:     input  logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][STRB_WIDTH-1:0]  m_req_strb_i,
72: 
73:     output logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                  m_rsp_valid_o,
74:     output logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  m_rsp_rdata_o,
75: 
76:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
77:     // SRAM Banks Interface (tới 32 Banks)
78:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
79:     output logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0]                    b_req_o,
80:     output logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0]                    b_write_o,
81:     output logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][BANK_ADDR_W-1:0]   b_addr_o,
82:     output logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    b_wdata_o,
83:     output logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][STRB_WIDTH-1:0]    b_strb_o,
84: 
85:     input  logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    b_rdata_i,
86:     input  logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0]                    b_rvalid_i
87: );
88: 
89:     // =========================================================================
90:     // 1. GIẢI MÃ ĐỊA CHỈ XEN KẼ (INTERLEAVED BANK DECODING)
91:     // =========================================================================
92:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][BANK_SEL_W-1:0]  m_target_bank;
93:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0][BANK_ADDR_W-1:0] m_bank_addr;
94:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][NUM_MASTERS-1:0]   bank_req_matrix;
95: 
96:     genvar m, b;
97:     generate
98:         for (m = 0; m < NUM_MASTERS; m++) begin : GEN_ADDR_DECODE
99:             // Bóc tách 5-bit Bank Index [8:4]
100:             assign m_target_bank[m] = m_req_addr_i[m][BYTE_OFFSET_W +: BANK_SEL_W];
101:             // Địa chỉ dòng bên trong từng Bank [18:9]
102:             assign m_bank_addr[m]   = m_req_addr_i[m][(BYTE_OFFSET_W + BANK_SEL_W) +: BANK_ADDR_W];
103: 
104:             for (b = 0; b < NUM_BANKS; b++) begin : GEN_REQ_MAP
105:                 assign bank_req_matrix[b][m] = m_req_valid_i[m] && (m_target_bank[m] == b);
106:             end
107:         end
108:     endgenerate
109: 
110:     // =========================================================================
111:     // 2. FIXED-PRIORITY PER-BANK ARBITRATION
112:     //    Stream engines (act/wt/out) always win over host/DMA on the same bank.
113:     // =========================================================================
114:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][NUM_MASTERS-1:0] bank_grant_matrix;
115:     logic [NUM_MASTERS-1:0]                master_granted;
116: 
117:     generate
118:         for (b = 0; b < NUM_BANKS; b++) begin : GEN_ARBITERS
119:             fixed_priority_arb_n #(
120:                 .NUM_REQS    (NUM_MASTERS),
121:                 .HOST_MASTER (HOST_MASTER),
122:                 .HOST_MASK   (HOST_MASK)
123:             ) u_bank_arb (
124:                 .req_i   (bank_req_matrix[b]),
125:                 .grant_o (bank_grant_matrix[b])
126:             );
127:         end
128:     endgenerate
129: 
130:     // Tính m_req_ready_o cho từng Master
131:     always_comb begin
132:         for (int i = 0; i < NUM_MASTERS; i++) begin
133:             master_granted[i] = 1'b0;
134:             for (int j = 0; j < NUM_BANKS; j++) begin
135:                 if (bank_grant_matrix[j][i]) begin
136:                     master_granted[i] = 1'b1;
137:                 end
138:             end
139:             m_req_ready_o[i] = master_granted[i];
140:         end
141:     end
142: 
143:     // =========================================================================
144:     // 3. MUX TÍN HIỆU GHI VÀO TỪNG BANK
145:     // =========================================================================
146:     always_comb begin
147:         for (int j = 0; j < NUM_BANKS; j++) begin
148:             b_req_o[j]   = |bank_grant_matrix[j];
149:             b_write_o[j] = 1'b0;
150:             b_addr_o[j]  = '0;
151:             b_wdata_o[j] = '0;
152:             b_strb_o[j]  = '0;
153: 
154:             for (int i = 0; i < NUM_MASTERS; i++) begin
155:                 if (bank_grant_matrix[j][i]) begin
156:                     b_write_o[j] = m_req_write_i[i];
157:                     b_addr_o[j]  = m_bank_addr[i];
158:                     b_wdata_o[j] = m_req_wdata_i[i];
159:                     b_strb_o[j]  = m_req_strb_i[i];
160:                 end
161:             end
162:         end
163:     end
164: 
165:     // =========================================================================
166:     // 4. THEO VẾT ĐƯỜNG ỐNG PHẢN HỒI ĐỌC (PIPELINED RESPONSE TRACKER)
167:     // =========================================================================
168:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0][$clog2(NUM_MASTERS)-1:0] grant_master_id_q;
169:     logic [NUM_BANKS-1:0]                          read_in_flight_q;
170: 
171:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
172:         if (!rst_n) begin
173:             read_in_flight_q  <= '0;
174:             grant_master_id_q <= '0;
175:         end else begin
176:             for (int j = 0; j < NUM_BANKS; j++) begin
177:                 read_in_flight_q[j] <= 1'b0;
178:                 for (int i = 0; i < NUM_MASTERS; i++) begin
179:                     if (bank_grant_matrix[j][i] && !m_req_write_i[i]) begin
180:                         read_in_flight_q[j]  <= 1'b1;
181:                         grant_master_id_q[j] <= i;
182:                     end
183:                 end
184:             end
185:         end
186:     end
187: 
188:     // Định tuyến dữ liệu đọc trả về đúng Master
189:     always_comb begin
190:         m_rsp_valid_o = '0;
191:         m_rsp_rdata_o = '0;
192: 
193:         for (int i = 0; i < NUM_MASTERS; i++) begin
194:             for (int j = 0; j < NUM_BANKS; j++) begin
195:                 if (b_rvalid_i[j] && read_in_flight_q[j] && (grant_master_id_q[j] == i)) begin
196:                     m_rsp_valid_o[i] = 1'b1;
197:                     m_rsp_rdata_o[i] = b_rdata_i[j];
198:                 end
199:             end
200:         end
201:     end
202: 
203: endmodule

2: // Module: multi_bank_tcdm_72b.sv
3: // Description: Multi-Bank Scratchpad Memory (TCDM) 32 Banks x 72-bit Data Width
4: //              - Mỗi Bank là 1 macro Single-Port (SP) SRAM đồng bộ (6T Bitcell)
5: //              - Hỗ trợ Byte Strobe 9-bit (72-bit = 9 bytes x 8 bits)
6: //              - Độ trễ đọc: đúng 1 chu kỳ clock (Single-cycle Read Latency)
7: // =============================================================================
8: `timescale 1ns/1ps
9: 
10: module sram_bank_72b #(
11:     parameter int unsigned DATA_WIDTH  = 72,
12:     parameter int unsigned STRB_WIDTH  = 9,
13:     parameter int unsigned BANK_DEPTH  = 1024,
14:     localparam int unsigned BANK_ADDR_W = $clog2(BANK_DEPTH)
15: )(
16:     input  logic                   clk,
17:     input  logic                   rst_n,
18: 
19:     input  logic                   req_i,
20:     input  logic                   write_i,
21:     input  logic [BANK_ADDR_W-1:0] addr_i,
22:     input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  wdata_i,
23:     input  logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0]  strb_i,
24: 
25:     output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  rdata_o,
26:     output logic                   rvalid_o
27: );
28: 
29:     // Mảng bộ nhớ SRAM (mỗi word gồm 9 bytes)
30:     logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0][7:0] mem [BANK_DEPTH];
31: 
32:     // Pipeline register đọc 1 cycle
33:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
34:         if (!rst_n) begin
35:             rdata_o  <= '0;
36:             rvalid_o <= 1'b0;
37:         end else begin
38:             rvalid_o <= req_i && !write_i;
39:             if (req_i) begin
40:                 if (write_i) begin
41:                     for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
42:                         if (strb_i[b]) begin
43:                             mem[addr_i][b] <= wdata_i[b*8 +: 8];
44:                         end
45:                     end
46:                 end else begin
47:                     rdata_o <= mem[addr_i];
48:                 end
49:             end
50:         end
51:     end
52: 
53: endmodule
54: 
55: 
56: module multi_bank_tcdm_72b #(
57:     parameter int unsigned NUM_BANKS   = 32,

60:     parameter int unsigned BANK_DEPTH  = 1024,

1: // =============================================================================
2: // Module: fixed_priority_arb_n
3: // Description: Fixed-priority per-bank arbiter for the 72-bit interconnect.
4: //
5: // Priority:
6: //   * Every non-host master (act/wt/output streamers) has priority over the
7: //     host/DMA master.
8: //   * Among non-host masters, the lowest master index wins (fixed priority).
9: //     With the current map: act(1) > wt(2..17) > out(18) > host(0).
10: //
11: // This implements the intended policy: a CPU/DMA access that collides with a
12: // stream-engine access to the same SRAM bank waits, while the stream engine
13: // keeps the bank and cannot stall the matmul core.
14: //
15: // NOTE: strict fixed priority can starve the host if a streamer continuously
16: // requests the same bank.  The host/DMA must tolerate `ready` being low for
17: // long periods, or the system must use double buffering / disjoint banks.
18: // =============================================================================
19: `timescale 1ns/1ps
20: 
21: module fixed_priority_arb_n #(
22:     parameter int unsigned NUM_REQS    = 19,
23:     parameter int unsigned HOST_MASTER = 0,
24:     // Optional extra low-priority masters (DMA + CPU in the clean top).  When
25:     // left at '0 the mask falls back to the single HOST_MASTER.
26:     parameter logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] HOST_MASK = '0
27: )(
28:     input  logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] req_i,
29:     output logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] grant_o
30: );
31: 
32:     logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] low_mask;
33:     logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] non_host_req;
34:     logic [NUM_REQS-1:0] non_host_grant;
35: 
36:     function automatic [NUM_REQS-1:0] onehot(input int unsigned idx);
37:         onehot = '0;
38:         onehot[idx] = 1'b1;
39:     endfunction
40: 
41:     assign low_mask      = (HOST_MASK == '0) ? onehot(HOST_MASTER) : HOST_MASK;
42:     assign non_host_req  = req_i & ~low_mask;
43: 
44:     // Lowest set bit = highest fixed priority among non-host masters.
45:     assign non_host_grant = non_host_req & ~(non_host_req - 1'b1);
46: 
47:     assign grant_o = (|non_host_req) ? non_host_grant :
48:                      (req_i & low_mask & ~((req_i & low_mask) - 1'b1));
49: 
50: endmodule

3: // =============================================================================
4: // Module: vsq_rescaler_32b
5: // Description: Dedicated 32-bit CSD Scaler and Arithmetic Shifter for Online
6: //              Accumulator Rescaling in FlashAttention.
7: //
8: // Mathematical Formulation:
9: //   Output = val_in * 2^(m_old - m_new)
10: //          = val_in * 2^(resc_q) * (m_r / 32)
11: //   where:
12: //     - resc_q <= 0 is the octave exponent
13: //     - resc_r in [0..7] selects the 3-term CSD multiplier m_r in {32,35,38,41,46,49,54,59}
14: //     - Zero hardware multipliers: implemented with hardwired shifts + 3:2 CSA + CPA
15: // =============================================================================
16: module vsq_rescaler_32b (
17:     input  logic signed [31:0] val_in,      // 32-bit Q16.16 accumulator operand
18:     input  logic signed [7:0]  resc_q,      // Octave shift (<= 0)
19:     input  logic        [2:0]  resc_r,      // Fractional CSD residual index [0..7]
20:     output logic signed [31:0] scaled_out   // Rescaled 32-bit Q16.16 operand
21: );
22: 
23:     // Sign-extend 32-bit input to 38 bits to hold up to 64 * val_in
24:     logic signed [37:0] val_ext;
25:     assign val_ext = {{6{val_in[31]}}, val_in};
26: 
27:     // Term 0: Select 64*val_in (for r >= 6) or 32*val_in (for r < 6)
28:     logic [37:0] t0;
29:     assign t0 = (resc_r[2] & resc_r[1]) ? (val_ext <<< 6) : (val_ext <<< 5);
30: 
31:     // Term 1 & Term 2 magnitudes and subtraction flags
32:     logic [37:0] t1_mag, t2_mag;
33:     logic        sub_t1, sub_t2;
34: 
35:     always_comb begin
36:         unique case (resc_r)
37:             3'd0: begin t1_mag = 38'd0;         sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = 38'd0;         sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32
38:             3'd1: begin t1_mag = (val_ext <<< 1); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = val_ext;         sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32 + 2 + 1 = 35
39:             3'd2: begin t1_mag = (val_ext <<< 2); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = (val_ext <<< 1); sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32 + 4 + 2 = 38
40:             3'd3: begin t1_mag = (val_ext <<< 3); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = val_ext;         sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32 + 8 + 1 = 41
41:             3'd4: begin t1_mag = (val_ext <<< 4); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = (val_ext <<< 1); sub_t2 = 1'b1; end // 32 + 16 - 2 = 46
42:             3'd5: begin t1_mag = (val_ext <<< 4); sub_t1 = 1'b0; t2_mag = val_ext;         sub_t2 = 1'b0; end // 32 + 16 + 1 = 49
43:             3'd6: begin t1_mag = (val_ext <<< 3); sub_t1 = 1'b1; t2_mag = (val_ext <<< 1); sub_t2 = 1'b1; end // 64 - 8 - 2 = 54
44:             3'd7: begin t1_mag = (val_ext <<< 2); sub_t1 = 1'b1; t2_mag = val_ext;         sub_t2 = 1'b1; end // 64 - 4 - 1 = 59
45:         endcase
46:     end
47: 
48:     // 1's complement inversion for subtraction
49:     logic [37:0] t1, t2;
50:     assign t1 = sub_t1 ? (~t1_mag) : t1_mag;
51:     assign t2 = sub_t2 ? (~t2_mag) : t2_mag;
52: 
53:     // Single 38-bit 3:2 Carry-Save Adder
54:     logic [37:0] csa_sum, csa_cout;
55:     assign csa_sum  = t0 ^ t1 ^ t2;
56:     assign csa_cout = (t0 & t1) | (t1 & t2) | (t0 & t2);
57: 
58:     // Left-shifted carry vector with sub_t1 absorbed at bit 0
59:     logic [37:0] csa_carry_shifted;
60:     assign csa_carry_shifted = {csa_cout[36:0], sub_t1};
61: 
62:     // 38-bit CPA with sub_t2 absorbed as carry-in
63:     logic signed [37:0] prod_38;
64:     assign prod_38 = $signed(csa_sum + csa_carry_shifted + 38'(sub_t2));
65: 
66:     // Net Right Shift Calculation:
67:     //   m_r is scaled by 32 (5 fractional bits).
68:     //   resc_q <= 0 represents an octave shift by 2^resc_q.
69:     //   Total right shift amount = 5 - resc_q >= 5.
70:     logic [5:0] net_rshift;
71:     always_comb begin
72:         if (resc_q < -8'sd26) begin
73:             net_rshift = 6'd32; // Underflow to 0
74:         end else begin
75:             net_rshift = 6'd5 + unsigned'(-resc_q[4:0]);
76:         end
77:     end
78: 
79:     // Arithmetic right shift with rounding bit
80:     logic signed [37:0] shifted_wide;
81:     assign shifted_wide = (prod_38 + (38'sd1 <<< (net_rshift - 1))) >>> net_rshift;
82: 
83:     // Output assignment (magnitude strictly decreases since 2^dm <= 1, no overflow)
84:     assign scaled_out = shifted_wide[31:0];
85: 
86: endmodule

3: // =============================================================================
4: // Module: p_fifo
5: // Description: Transient Ping-Pong / Ring FIFO for 72-bit FP4 Probability Packets.
6: //              Decouples Softmax Requantizer from MatMul 2 (P * V), keeping P
7: //              entirely on-chip without touching the Shared SRAM.
8: // =============================================================================
9: module p_fifo #(
10:     parameter int DATA_WIDTH = 72,
11:     parameter int DEPTH      = 4
12: )(
13:     input  logic                   clk,
14:     input  logic                   rst_n,
15:     input  logic                   clear,
16: 
17:     // Write Port (from softmax_requantizer)
18:     input  logic                   push,
19:     input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  wdata,
20:     output logic                   full,
21: 
22:     // Read Port (to vsq_matmul_engine act_broadcast)
23:     input  logic                   pop,
24:     output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  rdata,
25:     output logic                   empty,
26:     output logic [$clog2(DEPTH):0] count
27: );
28: 
29:     localparam int AW = $clog2(DEPTH);
30: 
31:     logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:DEPTH-1];
32:     logic [AW-1:0]         wptr, rptr;
33:     logic [$clog2(DEPTH):0] cnt;
34:     logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata_q;
35: 
36:     assign empty = (cnt == 0);
37:     assign full  = (cnt == DEPTH);
38:     assign count = cnt;
39:     assign rdata = rdata_q;
40: 
41:     wire [AW-1:0] next_rptr = (rptr == AW'(DEPTH-1)) ? '0 : rptr + 1'b1;
42: 
43:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
44:         if (!rst_n) begin
45:             wptr    <= '0;
46:             rptr    <= '0;
47:             cnt     <= '0;
48:             rdata_q <= '0;
49:         end else if (clear) begin
50:             wptr    <= '0;
51:             rptr    <= '0;
52:             cnt     <= '0;
53:             rdata_q <= '0;
54:         end else begin
55:             case ({push & ~full, pop & ~empty})
56:                 2'b10: begin // Push only
57:                     mem[wptr] <= wdata;
58:                     wptr      <= (wptr == AW'(DEPTH-1)) ? '0 : wptr + 1'b1;
59:                     cnt       <= cnt + 1'b1;
60:                     if (cnt == 0) begin
61:                         rdata_q <= wdata;
62:                     end
63:                 end
64:                 2'b01: begin // Pop only
65:                     rptr <= next_rptr;
66:                     cnt  <= cnt - 1'b1;
67:                     if (cnt > 1) begin
68:                         rdata_q <= mem[next_rptr];
69:                     end
70:                 end
71:                 2'b11: begin // Simultaneous push and pop
72:                     mem[wptr] <= wdata;
73:                     wptr      <= (wptr == AW'(DEPTH-1)) ? '0 : wptr + 1'b1;
74:                     rptr      <= next_rptr;
75:                     if (cnt == 1) begin
76:                         rdata_q <= wdata;
77:                     end else begin
78:                         rdata_q <= mem[next_rptr];
79:                     end
80:                 end
81:                 default: ; // Idle
82:             endcase
83:         end
84:     end
85: 
86: endmodule

1: // =============================================================================
2: // Module: snax_streamer_act_bcast.sv
3: // Description: Clean, High-PPA Activation / Query Broadcast Read Streamer
4: // - Connects to TCDM Master Port 1 (72-bit Data Width)
5: // - Unified 2D Nested Loop AGU:
6: //     * Inner Loop (Loop 0): Tokens (0 .. cfg_tokens_i - 1)
7: //     * Outer Loop (Loop 1): K-Blocks / d_k (0 .. cfg_k_blocks_i - 1)
8: // - Matches Weight Streamer & Accumulator Latch Slots (0..15)
9: // - Canonical Elastic Skid Buffer (depth parameterised) for zero-bubble
10: //   handshaking
11: // =============================================================================
12: `timescale 1ns/1ps
13: 
14: module snax_streamer_act_bcast #(
15:   parameter int unsigned DATA_WIDTH = 72, // 72-bit Packet (64b FP4 + 8b Exp)
16:   parameter int unsigned ADDR_WIDTH = 32, // 32-bit Address
17:   parameter int unsigned STRB_WIDTH = 9,  // 9-bit Byte Strobe
18:   // Pipeline depth of the read path.  Must be >= the TCDM read round trip
19:   // (interconnect request register + bank register + response window), or the
20:   // core stalls every beat waiting for the next token.
21:   // 4 covers the ~3-cycle read round trip; going deeper does not help, the
22:   // residual stalls are the pipeline fill at each launch, not steady state.
23:   parameter int unsigned SKID_DEPTH = 4
24: )(
25:   input  logic                  clk,
26:   input  logic                  rst_n,
27: 
28:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
29:   // 1. CSR Control & 2D AGU Configuration
30:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
31:   input  logic                  csr_start_i,
32:   output logic                  busy_o,
33:   output logic                  done_irq_o,
34: 
35:   input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cfg_base_addr_i,    // Địa chỉ gốc trong TCDM (ví dụ Bank 16)
36:   input  logic [31:0]           cfg_tokens_i,       // Số token trong mẻ (Loop 0: Vòng lặp trong)
37:   input  logic [31:0]           cfg_token_stride_i, // Bước nhảy địa chỉ sang token kế (giữa các bank)
38:   input  logic [31:0]           cfg_k_blocks_i,     // Số block K / d_k (Loop 1: Vòng lặp ngoài)
39:   input  logic [31:0]           cfg_k_stride_i,     // Bước nhảy địa chỉ sang block K kế (chiều dọc)
40: 
41:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
42:   // 2. TCDM Interconnect Master Port 1
43:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
44:   output logic                  m_tcdm_req_valid_o,
45:   output logic                  m_tcdm_req_write_o,
46:   output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] m_tcdm_req_addr_o,
47:   output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_tcdm_req_wdata_o,
48:   output logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] m_tcdm_req_strb_o,
49:   input  logic                  m_tcdm_req_ready_i,
50: 
51:   input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_tcdm_rsp_rdata_i,
52:   input  logic                  m_tcdm_rsp_valid_i,
53: 
54:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
55:   // 3. Accelerator Shell Interface (ext_act_broadcast_i/valid/ready)
56:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
57:   output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] act_stream_data_o,
58:   output logic                  act_stream_valid_o,
59:   input  logic                  act_stream_ready_i
60: );
61: 
62:   // =========================================================================
63:   // 1. TỐI GIẢN FSM & 2D AGU CONTROLLER
64:   // =========================================================================
65:   typedef enum logic [1:0] { IDLE, STREAM, DRAIN_WAIT } state_t;
66:   state_t state_q, state_d;
67: 
68:   logic [31:0] tok_cnt_q, tok_cnt_d;
69:   logic [31:0] k_cnt_q,   k_cnt_d;
70:   logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] curr_addr_q, curr_addr_d;
71:   logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] k_base_addr_q, k_base_addr_d;
72: 
73:   // Job descriptor, sampled at start.  A producer is free to change cfg_*
74:   // after the launch pulse, so the AGU must not read them live.
75:   logic [31:0]           tokens_q,      token_stride_q;
76:   logic [31:0]           k_blocks_q,    k_stride_q;
77: 
78:   // Điều kiện biên vòng lặp
79:   wire tok_last = (tok_cnt_q == tokens_q - 1'b1);
80:   wire k_last   = (k_cnt_q   == k_blocks_q - 1'b1);
81: 
82:   // Bắt tay với Elastic Skid Buffer
83:   localparam int unsigned PTR_W   = (SKID_DEPTH > 1) ? $clog2(SKID_DEPTH) : 1;
84:   localparam int unsigned LEVEL_W = $clog2(SKID_DEPTH + 1);
85: 
86:   logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] skid_mem [0:SKID_DEPTH-1];
87:   logic [PTR_W-1:0]   wr_p, rd_p;
88:   logic [LEVEL_W-1:0] count;
89:   wire skid_ready = (count < LEVEL_W'(SKID_DEPTH));
90:   wire skid_valid = (count != '0);
91: 
92:   wire tcdm_fire = m_tcdm_req_valid_o && m_tcdm_req_ready_i;
93:   wire core_fire = act_stream_valid_o && act_stream_ready_i;
94: 
95:   // Outstanding-read credit: the AGU advances on request acceptance, so the
96:   // request stream can outrun TCDM responses.  Buffered + outstanding entries
97:   // must stay below SKID_DEPTH so a returning response can never overflow the
98:   // buffer.  The window is the same SKID_DEPTH, which lets the streamer keep
99:   // the whole read latency in flight instead of one token per beat.
100:   logic [LEVEL_W-1:0] outstanding_q, outstanding_d;
101:   wire req_counted = tcdm_fire && (state_q == STREAM);
102:   wire rsp_counted = m_tcdm_rsp_valid_i && (state_q == STREAM || state_q == DRAIN_WAIT);
103:   wire issue_ok    = skid_ready & ((outstanding_q + count) < LEVEL_W'(SKID_DEPTH));
104: 
105:   always_comb begin
106:     state_d       = state_q;
107:     tok_cnt_d     = tok_cnt_q;
108:     k_cnt_d       = k_cnt_q;
109:     curr_addr_d   = curr_addr_q;
110:     k_base_addr_d = k_base_addr_q;
111:     outstanding_d = outstanding_q;
112:     done_irq_o    = 1'b0;
113: 
114:     m_tcdm_req_valid_o = 1'b0;
115:     m_tcdm_req_write_o = 1'b0; // Đọc
116:     m_tcdm_req_addr_o  = curr_addr_q;
117:     m_tcdm_req_wdata_o = '0;
118:     m_tcdm_req_strb_o  = '0;
119: 
120:     case (state_q)
121:       IDLE: begin
122:         if (csr_start_i) begin
123:           state_d       = STREAM;
124:           tok_cnt_d     = '0;
125:           k_cnt_d       = '0;
126:           curr_addr_d   = cfg_base_addr_i;
127:           k_base_addr_d = cfg_base_addr_i;
128:         end
129:       end
130: 
131:       STREAM: begin
132:         m_tcdm_req_valid_o = issue_ok;
133: 
134:         if (tcdm_fire) begin
135:           // VÒNG LẶP TRONG: Quét lần lượt từng Token trong mẻ (ví dụ 16 tokens)
136:           if (!tok_last) begin
137:             tok_cnt_d   = tok_cnt_q + 1'b1;
138:             curr_addr_d = curr_addr_q + token_stride_q; // Nhảy sang Token kế tiếp
139:           end else begin
140:             tok_cnt_d = '0;
141:             // VÒNG LẶP NGOÀI: Khi duyệt xong mẻ token, tăng 1 block K_dim
142:             if (!k_last) begin
143:               k_cnt_d       = k_cnt_q + 1'b1;
144:               k_base_addr_d = k_base_addr_q + k_stride_q;
145:               curr_addr_d   = k_base_addr_q + k_stride_q; // Reset về token 0 của block K mới
146:             end else begin
147:               state_d = DRAIN_WAIT;
148:             end
149:           end
150:         end
151:       end
152: 
153:       DRAIN_WAIT: begin
154:         // Wait for both the skid buffer and all outstanding reads.
155:         if (count == '0 && outstanding_q == '0) begin
156:           done_irq_o = 1'b1;
157:           state_d    = IDLE;
158:         end
159:       end
160: 
161:       default: state_d = IDLE;
162:     endcase
163: 
164:     if (req_counted)
165:       outstanding_d = outstanding_d + 1'b1;
166:     if (rsp_counted && (outstanding_q != 3'd0))
167:       outstanding_d = outstanding_d - 1'b1;
168:   end
169: 
170:   always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
171:     if (!rst_n) begin
172:       state_q       <= IDLE;
173:       tok_cnt_q     <= '0;
174:       k_cnt_q       <= '0;
175:       curr_addr_q   <= '0;
176:       k_base_addr_q <= '0;
177:       outstanding_q <= '0;
178:     end else begin
179:       state_q       <= state_d;
180:       tok_cnt_q     <= tok_cnt_d;
181:       k_cnt_q       <= k_cnt_d;
182:       curr_addr_q   <= curr_addr_d;
183:       k_base_addr_q <= k_base_addr_d;
184:       outstanding_q <= outstanding_d;
185: 
186:       if (csr_start_i) begin
187:         tokens_q       <= cfg_tokens_i;
188:         token_stride_q <= cfg_token_stride_i;
189:         k_blocks_q     <= cfg_k_blocks_i;
190:         k_stride_q     <= cfg_k_stride_i;
191:       end
192:     end
193:   end
194: 
195:   // =========================================================================
196:   // 2. ELASTIC SKID BUFFER (SKID_DEPTH entries)
197:   // =========================================================================
198:   always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
199:     if (!rst_n) begin
200:       wr_p  <= '0;
201:       rd_p  <= '0;
202:       count <= '0;
203:     end else if (state_q == STREAM || state_q == DRAIN_WAIT) begin
204:       case ({m_tcdm_rsp_valid_i, core_fire})
205:         2'b10: begin // Push from TCDM
206:           skid_mem[wr_p] <= m_tcdm_rsp_rdata_i;
207:           wr_p           <= wr_p + 1'b1;
208:           count          <= count + 1'b1;
209:         end
210:         2'b01: begin // Pop to Core
211:           rd_p  <= rd_p + 1'b1;
212:           count <= count - 1'b1;
213:         end
214:         2'b11: begin // Back-to-back simultaneous Push & Pop
215:           skid_mem[wr_p] <= m_tcdm_rsp_rdata_i;
216:           wr_p           <= wr_p + 1'b1;
217:           rd_p           <= rd_p + 1'b1;
218:         end
219:         default: ;
220:       endcase
221:     end
222:   end
223: 
224:   // Đầu ra đi trực tiếp từ Skid Buffer, không qua Mux phụ
225:   assign act_stream_data_o  = skid_mem[rd_p];
226:   assign act_stream_valid_o = skid_valid;
227: 
228:   assign busy_o = (state_q != IDLE) || (count != '0);
229: 
230: endmodule

1: // =============================================================================
2: // Module: snax_streamer_wt_16ch.sv
3: // Description: Clean, High-PPA 16-Channel Parallel Weight/Key/Value Streamer
4: //              - Connects to TCDM Interconnect via Masters 2..17 (1152 bits/cycle)
5: //              - 3D Nested Loop AGU (Loops: Replay, K-Block, Tile)
6: //              - Bank-Interleaved Zero-Conflict Fanout:
7: //                    Addr[w] = cfg_base_addr_i + w*16
8: //                cfg_base_addr_i is the real TCDM byte address of lane 0
9: //                (16-byte aligned); lane banks start at base[8:4].
10: //              - 16x Elastic Skid Buffers with FIFO-head replay
11: //              - 16-Lane Barrier Synchronizer for lock-step Core delivery
12: //
13: // Replay semantics:
14: //   One TCDM read is fetched per (tile, K-block) vector. The FIFO head is held
15: //   for cfg_repeat_tokens core handshakes; it is popped only on the last
16: //   handshake. No TCDM request is issued while a replay is active.
17: // =============================================================================
18: `timescale 1ns/1ps
19: 
20: module snax_streamer_wt_16ch #(
21:     parameter int unsigned DATA_WIDTH = 72,   // 72-bit Packet (64b FP4 + 8b Exp)
22:     parameter int unsigned ADDR_WIDTH = 32,   // 32-bit Address
23:     parameter int unsigned NUM_LANES  = 16,   // 16 Parallel Lanes
24:     parameter int unsigned STRB_WIDTH = 9     // 9-bit Byte Strobe
25: )(
26:     input  logic                                  clk,
27:     input  logic                                  rst_n,
28: 
29:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
30:     // 1. CSR Control & 3D AGU Configuration
31:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
32:     input  logic                                  csr_start_i,
33:     output logic                                  busy_o,
34:     output logic                                  done_irq_o,
35: 
36:     input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]                 cfg_base_addr_i,    // Real TCDM byte address of lane 0 (16B aligned)
37:     input  logic [31:0]                           cfg_repeat_tokens_i,// Replay count per vector
38:     input  logic [31:0]                           cfg_k_blocks_i,     // Số blocks theo chiều K (Loop 1)
39:     input  logic [31:0]                           cfg_k_stride_i,     // Bước nhảy sang block K kế
40:     input  logic [31:0]                           cfg_num_tiles_i,    // Số tiles trọng số (Loop 2)
41:     input  logic [31:0]                           cfg_tile_step_i,    // Bước nhảy sang tile kế
42: 
43:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
44:     // 2. TCDM Interconnect Master Ports (Masters 2..17)
45:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
46:     output logic [NUM_LANES-1:0]                  m_tcdm_req_valid_o,
47:     output logic [NUM_LANES-1:0]                  m_tcdm_req_write_o,
48:     output logic [NUM_LANES-1:0][ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]  m_tcdm_req_addr_o,
49:     output logic [NUM_LANES-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  m_tcdm_req_wdata_o,
50:     output logic [NUM_LANES-1:0][STRB_WIDTH-1:0]  m_tcdm_req_strb_o,
51:     input  logic [NUM_LANES-1:0]                  m_tcdm_req_ready_i,
52: 
53:     input  logic [NUM_LANES-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  m_tcdm_rsp_rdata_i,
54:     input  logic [NUM_LANES-1:0]                  m_tcdm_rsp_valid_i,
55: 
56:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
57:     // 3. Accelerator Shell Interface (wt_stream_*)
58:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
59:     output logic [NUM_LANES-1:0][DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  wt_stream_data_o ,
60:     output logic [NUM_LANES-1:0]                  wt_stream_valid_o,
61:     input  logic [NUM_LANES-1:0]                  wt_stream_ready_i
62: );
63: 
64:     // =========================================================================
65:     // 1. FSM & 3D AGU COUNTERS
66:     // =========================================================================
67:     typedef enum logic [1:0] { IDLE, RUN, DRAIN_WAIT } state_t;
68:     state_t state_q, state_d;
69: 
70:     logic [31:0] rep_cnt_q,   rep_cnt_d;
71:     logic [31:0] kb_cnt_q,    kb_cnt_d;
72:     logic [31:0] tile_cnt_q,  tile_cnt_d;
73:     logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] base_addr_q, base_addr_d;
74:     logic                  replay_active_q, replay_active_d;
75: 
76:     // Job descriptor, sampled at start.  A producer is free to change cfg_*
77:     // after the launch cycle, so every field must be captured here.
78:     logic [31:0] repeat_q, k_blocks_q, num_tiles_q, k_stride_q, tile_step_q;
79: 
80:     // Rollovers
81:     wire rep_last  = (rep_cnt_q  == repeat_q    - 1'b1);
82:     wire kb_last   = (kb_cnt_q   == k_blocks_q  - 1'b1);
83:     wire tile_last = (tile_cnt_q == num_tiles_q - 1'b1);
84: 
85:     // =========================================================================
86:     // 2. SKID BUFFER HANDSHAKE
87:     // =========================================================================
88:     logic [NUM_LANES-1:0] skid_ready, skid_valid;
89:     logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] skid_data_out [0:NUM_LANES-1];
90:     logic [1:0]            skid_level   [0:NUM_LANES-1];
91: 
92:     wire all_skids_ready = &skid_ready;
93:     wire all_lanes_ready = &skid_valid;
94:     wire all_core_ready  = &wt_stream_ready_i;
95:     wire tcdm_all_gnt    = &m_tcdm_req_ready_i;
96: 
97:     // A vector is consumed only when all 16 lanes handshake together.
98:     wire core_pop_group = all_lanes_ready && all_core_ready;
99:     wire core_pop_last  = core_pop_group && rep_last;
100: 
101:     // Fetch exactly one vector per (tile, K-block); no fetch during replay.
102:     wire req_fire = (state_q == RUN) && !replay_active_q && all_skids_ready && tcdm_all_gnt;
103: 
104:     // =========================================================================
105:     // 3. FSM & AGU
106:     // =========================================================================
107:     always_comb begin
108:         state_d         = state_q;
109:         rep_cnt_d       = rep_cnt_q;
110:         kb_cnt_d        = kb_cnt_q;
111:         tile_cnt_d      = tile_cnt_q;
112:         base_addr_d     = base_addr_q;
113:         replay_active_d = replay_active_q;
114:         done_irq_o      = 1'b0;
115: 
116:         case (state_q)
117:             IDLE: begin
118:                 if (csr_start_i) begin
119:                     state_d         = RUN;
120:                     rep_cnt_d       = '0;
121:                     kb_cnt_d        = '0;
122:                     tile_cnt_d      = '0;
123:                     base_addr_d     = cfg_base_addr_i;
124:                     replay_active_d = 1'b0;
125:                 end
126:             end
127: 
128:             RUN: begin
129:                 if (core_pop_group) begin
130:                     if (rep_last) begin
131:                         // Last replay: pop the FIFO head and advance the AGU.
132:                         rep_cnt_d       = '0;
133:                         replay_active_d = 1'b0;
134:                         if (!kb_last) begin
135:                             kb_cnt_d    = kb_cnt_q + 1'b1;
136:                             base_addr_d = base_addr_q + k_stride_q;
137:                         end else begin
138:                             kb_cnt_d = '0;
139:                             if (!tile_last) begin
140:                                 tile_cnt_d  = tile_cnt_q + 1'b1;
141:                                 base_addr_d = base_addr_q + tile_step_q;
142:                             end else begin
143:                                 state_d = DRAIN_WAIT;
144:                             end
145:                         end
146:                     end else begin
147:                         rep_cnt_d = rep_cnt_q + 1'b1;
148:                     end
149:                 end else if (req_fire) begin
150:                     // One TCDM fetch; the head is replayed from now on.
151:                     replay_active_d = 1'b1;
152:                 end
153:             end
154: 
155:             DRAIN_WAIT: begin
156:                 if (!skid_valid) begin
157:                     done_irq_o = 1'b1;
158:                     state_d    = IDLE;
159:                 end
160:             end
161: 
162:             default: state_d = IDLE;
163:         endcase
164:     end
165: 
166:     always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
167:         if (!rst_n) begin
168:             state_q         <= IDLE;
169:             rep_cnt_q       <= '0;
170:             kb_cnt_q        <= '0;
171:             tile_cnt_q      <= '0;
172:             base_addr_q     <= '0;
173:             replay_active_q <= 1'b0;
174:             repeat_q        <= '0;
175:             k_blocks_q      <= 32'd1;
176:             num_tiles_q     <= 32'd1;
177:             k_stride_q      <= '0;
178:             tile_step_q     <= '0;
179:         end else begin
180:             state_q         <= state_d;
181:             rep_cnt_q       <= rep_cnt_d;
182:             kb_cnt_q        <= kb_cnt_d;
183:             tile_cnt_q      <= tile_cnt_d;
184:             base_addr_q     <= base_addr_d;
185:             replay_active_q <= replay_active_d;
186: 
187:             if (state_q == IDLE && csr_start_i) begin
188:                 repeat_q    <= cfg_repeat_tokens_i;
189:                 k_blocks_q  <= cfg_k_blocks_i;
190:                 num_tiles_q <= cfg_num_tiles_i;
191:                 k_stride_q  <= cfg_k_stride_i;
192:                 tile_step_q <= cfg_tile_step_i;
193:             end
194:         end
195:     end
196: 
197:     // =========================================================================
198:     // 4. 16-WAY ZERO-CONFLICT INTERLEAVED ADDRESS FANOUT
199:     // =========================================================================
200:     genvar w;
201:     generate
202:         for (w = 0; w < NUM_LANES; w++) begin : GEN_TCDM_REQS
203:             assign m_tcdm_req_valid_o[w] =
204:                 (state_q == RUN) && !replay_active_q && all_skids_ready;
205:             assign m_tcdm_req_write_o[w] = 1'b0;
206:             // cfg_base_addr_i is the real TCDM address of lane 0.
207:             // Lane w is 16 bytes higher, i.e. the next bank at the same word.
208:             assign m_tcdm_req_addr_o[w]  = base_addr_q + (w << 4);
209:             assign m_tcdm_req_wdata_o[w] = '0;
210:             assign m_tcdm_req_strb_o[w]  = '0;
211:         end
212:     endgenerate
213: 
214:     // =========================================================================
215:     // 5. 16x SKID BUFFERS (FIFO HEAD HELD DURING REPLAY)
216:     // =========================================================================
217:     generate
218:         for (w = 0; w < NUM_LANES; w++) begin : GEN_SKID_BUFFERS
219:             skid_buffer #(
220:                 .DATA_WIDTH (DATA_WIDTH),
221:                 .DEPTH      (2)
222:             ) u_skid_buffer (
223:                 .clk        (clk),
224:                 .rst_n      (rst_n),
225:                 .push       (m_tcdm_rsp_valid_i[w]),
226:                 .data_in    (m_tcdm_rsp_rdata_i[w]),
227:                 .pop        (core_pop_last),
228:                 .data_out   (skid_data_out[w]),
229:                 .ready      (skid_ready[w]),
230:                 .valid      (skid_valid[w]),
231:                 .level      (skid_level[w])
232:             );
233:         end
234:     endgenerate
235: 
236:     // =========================================================================
237:     // 6. 16-LANE BARRIER OUTPUT
238:     // =========================================================================
239:     generate
240:         for (w = 0; w < NUM_LANES; w++) begin : GEN_OUTPUTS
241:             assign wt_stream_data_o[w]  = skid_data_out[w];
242:             assign wt_stream_valid_o[w] = all_lanes_ready;
243:         end
244:     endgenerate
245: 
246:     assign busy_o = (state_q != IDLE) || (|skid_valid);
247: 
248: endmodule
